storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Everyone quickly accepted one fact: where there's Jenkin, there's Brown, and where there's Brown, there's Jenkin. And whenever Brown acted alone—make no mistake—Jenkin was behind it.

"What do you mean by 'stolen'? I have an alibi!"

So said the girl, holding the item Brown had "borrowed."

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
A.F. 315, @2@1, 08:13 a.m.

MTC On-Site Response Team 3 and members of the Dissolution Item Control and Management (DISM) Group β7 arrived at Dissolution Area L-E-933 (formerly the Rogers Wax Museum, @2 Southwark Street) to take over the task from MTC Team 1 and DISM Group α2, conducting area neutralization work.

09:24 a.m.

While clearing the subterranean area of the museum, DISM member James exhibited symptoms including headaches, nausea, and vertigo.

10:47 a.m.

Rowland (Team 3), Zachary (DISM), and Bolton (DISM) fled the subterranean area. The trio reported that the underground darkness swallowed them, plunging them into a floating starry void. Tangible colors intertwined within the space—gorgeous yet bone-chilling. These colors then condensed into countless rats that rapidly surged toward them.

Bolton refused to continue and returned to the Committee's Londinium office. Rowland and Zachary accompanied Team 3 Captain Fisher back into the underground area for further inspection.

1:03 p.m.

Following a systematic search, Captain Fisher located and recovered Silver Core L3202 from the residual dissolution wax in the underground area. It was then transferred to Mythag University for further processing.

—<Italic:Neutralization Report of Dissolution Area L-E-933>

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Jenkin's overly nimble hands once raised concerns that she'd become a fixture in the <Italic:Mythag Daily>—not as an interviewee, but as the mastermind behind several thefts.

Though she did become a regular of the paper, it wasn't due to old habits. Provided there were enough pastries, even a master street survivalist was willing to set aside her former trade and enjoy a well-earned retirement alongside her mouse buddy.

The real reason she appeared in the paper so often? The editor pays far too generously.

Shh—keep your voice down, you never know where she might be, ready to trade what she's overheard with Hannahh for more candies and cakes.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
"I'm not an orphan," said six-year-old Jenkin. "My mom just went to work. She'll pick me up after she's done."

She never wavered, nor did she dare to. This belief was the protective incantation she clung to whenever she jolted awake at night from nightmares filled with black slime. It was her only comfort whenever she tried to recall her mother's face but could only see a black shadow.

Gritting her teeth, she stood watch at the welfare home's gate through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Only on the morning the home closed down did she wipe away her unseen tears and leave with her mouse friend.

"I am an orphan," said ten-year-old Jenkin. "I don't have parents. I only have Brown."

She told this to herself and the mouse perched on her shoulder. It was true—people might be wary of children suddenly approaching; East End street children were infamous throughout Londinium—but no one suspected a mouse scurrying by their feet. Through this tacit cooperation, the girl occasionally enjoyed a full meal, and dreamed in the sewers of fireplaces and pastries.

Yet the bitter winter spared no one. It brought her sickness and high fever, bringing the Grim Reaper to a halt by her side. The girl lay dying, with only the mouse circling frantically about her, hoping for any attention at all.

A young woman stopped and wrapped the girl in a warm embrace.

"I'm not an orphan," said thirteen-year-old Jenkin. "I have my sister Mason and my best friend Brown!"

The girl stood before an old house, holding the mouse close, her face bright with a radiant smile.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Street life was never difficult for her.

When hungry, she looked for work; if there were no jobs, she resorted to her own "handiwork" to get by. She and Brown worked in such perfect sync that they could scrape by without anyone else's help.

/n"We don't need anyone," she vowed, the mouse on her shoulder squeaking in agreement. "We only need each other."

But every snowy night, she could not help but gaze at those windows glowing with warm yellow light, watching the people inside embrace and share warm wishes over a meager dinner.

It wasn't that she needed a roof over her head or soft pillows on a luxurious bed—she already had a companion she could trust. Yet she remained curious: what did it feel like to have a home for good?

That question found its answer the day Mason adopted her.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
A.F. 1@2/@1/@1 10:31 AM, the police received a report of multiple bloodstains discovered within @1@1 Manor. Detective Belford immediately headed to the scene, began an investigation, and found an unidentified bluish-green slime within the bloodstains.

13:44, Detective Belford submitted the report, and the Mystia Treaty Committee promptly took over the case.

14:25, the seventh response team of the committee arrived at the manor, controlled the related personnel, and sealed off the site. Based on the situation at the scene, the team leader speculated that there were at least five victims within the manor, and multiple instances of D-Phenomenon were observed.

18:00, investigators from Mythag University arrived at the scene, confirmed the existence of the D-phenomenon, and entered the manor with the Awakener for cleanup and investigation.

23:11, the cleanup of the manor was completed. Investigators discovered a large number of mystical documents and ritual materials in the basement and study's secret room, and found an incomplete Awakener. The Awakener identified herself as "Maid Karen," the chief maid of Duke @3. When discovered, the Awakener was dressed in a maid's uniform, adorned with various styles of jewelry, and was working very hard to clean the basement. This Awakener had a human form, bluish-green skin, and semi-transparent adhesive-like extremities, suspected to be an incomplete or erroneously summoned product. The slime secreted from her matched in texture and color with the substance found on the severed limbs.

The investigators questioned her, and Maid Karen admitted to @1 facts and expressed that everything was to gain her master's attention. Upon learning that Duke @3 would be arrested, she murmured, "Then where is my new master?" and then disassembled into gel, leaving behind a Silver.

01:37, the team leader of the seventh response team interrogated the related personnel and detained @1@1 Manor's owner, Duke @3, according to the "Treaty." 

03:09, investigators returned to Mythag University and logged the K-033 Silver into the database.

—"Incident Report of @1@1 Manor"

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Uniforms must be steamed and ironed, quilts must be hand washed, the fireplace must be spotless in summer and always have a fire burning in winter. Wooden floors must gleam, bookshelves must be dust-free, and black tea must always be kept at the right temperature for easy enjoyment.

For her noble, special, and unique new master—the Keeper who has given her life anew—she can do anything. She is the best maid in the world and must certainly be able to complete every task perfectly, refining every detail.

Her master's praise always makes her extraordinarily happy, but it's not enough, still not enough. What can she do to gain more attention from her master? What can she do to make herself more eye-catching?

"It must be the lack of earrings, necklaces, bracelets, rings, and hair ornaments!"She thrust the broom into the ground and muttered to herself, "As long as I have shiny jewelry decorations, Karen will surely become cuter, and everyone will enjoy looking at Karen even more!"

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Soft black hair, full cheeks, eyes as bright as gemstones, and rosy lips—from childhood, Karen had always enjoyed special favor due to her natural beauty. By the time she reached adulthood, the gifts and flowers bestowed upon her by men daily could pile into a small mountain at her doorstep. Thus, she was not at all surprised when the palace steward announced she would be brought to the royal court to be trained as a noble handmaiden to the King. Was this not only right? She was born to be envied, born to be extraordinary, and born to be the center of attention.

Yet, beauty was the most common currency within the palace walls. No matter how breathtaking a flower from a small town might be, it appeared ordinary and rustic in such a place. Her appearance could no longer buy her special treatment; even the opportunity she craved most—to serve in the Great Hall during the Centennial Feast—was snatched away by another girl.

Why? Whatever that girl possessed, Karen possessed as well. Why was it not her?

Then, her eyes fell upon the silver ornaments hanging from the other girl’s ears, and she understood.

On the day of the banquet, she drowned the girl in the lake and donned the silver-white earrings herself. Just as she had envisioned, she became the most radiant among the handmaidens, even earning the privilege of serving at the King’s side. The gazes of envy and jealousy from those around her filled her with an exquisite thrill—yes, yes, this was how it was meant to be. This was the happiest day of her life.

Shortly thereafter, she met her end within the emerald mist that swallowed the entire royal city.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Ruby earrings, sapphire necklaces, beautiful hair accessories woven from garnet and malachite... How dazzling, how beautiful, how full of charm they are! Wherever they appear, people flock to them.

These jewelry pendants are not mere "decorative items," no, they are the true stars of the world. Noble ladies wearing turquoise necklaces are immortalized in songs by poets; elderly ladies adorned with emeralds are seen as symbols of nobility. Even those lowborn girls, with a cheap bracelet on their wrist, can earn the endearing title of "Pearl Girl," attracting countless gazes.

Even dry branches and putrid bones can become objects of everyone's desire when adorned with a string of beautiful jewels.

If she could wear those necklaces and earrings, those bracelets and headpieces, surely she would become the center of attention as well.

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Kathigu-Ra excels at using her signature smile to draw out the cruel, crazed chill that lurks in the deepest reaches of any observer's awareness.

Those two inseparable twin guns, with powder dust swirling around their barrels, warn every ill-intentioned petty criminal that the sacrifice of the nameless is the cornerstone of all greatness.

However, anyone who has truly dealt with her will understand that hunting these ordinary, sunless people is merely her pastime during the tedium of daily life.

After all, when she truly opens fire, the barrels hold no gunpowder at all.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
■File Number: DIOL-A3-1
■Awakener Code Name: ■■■■
A.F.3@2, this Awakener initiated contact with Mythag.

"Sun! Sun! I saw the Sun! No! No!! Destroy it! Or we will all die!"

According to eyewitness accounts, the involved personnel shouted the above statement upon discovering this Awakener, and then ordered relevant units to attack it.

Due to the incorrect judgment of the involved personnel, this Awakener displayed extreme aggression, directly resulting in the destruction of 31 anti-Awakener units, 76 standard equipment sets, and 2 academic buildings, with total property damage estimated at @2@4. The case has now been transferred to the relevant department for accountability procedures.

Post-incident investigation revealed that this individual had been brainwashed by the Church of the Lightbearers. For subsequent details, please refer to related documents, as it will not be elaborated in this file.

After a period of communication, negotiation personnel successfully convinced the Awakener to abandon its aggressive stance. Subsequently, the Awakener handed a letter signed by Lord Dexter to the school administration, claiming it was the last possession of a missing Investigator. Later confirmation by Lord Dexter verified the authenticity of the letter.

It is currently known that, through the mediation of Professor Doll, this Awakener has reached a certain agreement with the school administration. In exchange for some unspecified compensation, the Awakener has agreed to undertake certain commissions that the school finds difficult or inconvenient to handle directly.

Given the destructive capability demonstrated by this Awakener, despite displaying the highest level of stability and communicability in subsequent conversations, the Committee has decided to include it in the DIOL and will continue updating its file under the highest protocol.

May the Silver Key guide us.

Recorder: L. Nadia

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
■File Number: DIOL-A3-9
■Awakener Code: ■■■■

From continuous observation, it appears this Awakener does not show any unusual interest in Mythag—she seems almost indifferent. She only comes to campus when accepting commissions and leaves quickly afterward.

Although the returned investigation report indeed records several instances of her lingering on campus for extended periods,

further investigation revealed that her primary reason for staying was helping students resolve certain issues. It has been determined there is no security threat involved, so no intervention is necessary.

One point worth noting is that this Awakener appears unusually interested in the Keeper. She has repeatedly brought the Keeper @3 items classified as contraband and invited the Keeper to various dinners attended by unknown individuals. Considering the Keeper's importance to Mythag, if this Awakener attempts any dangerous action against the Keeper, at least four γ-class armed personnel must be arranged to ensure the Keeper's safe evacuation.

Recorder: K. Trak

(Small handwriting on the back of the file)

Hey, buddy. Or perhaps sister—it doesn't matter.

The last poor bastard quit, and now I'm stuck with this damn project.

If you're reading this, it means you're not some lazy good-for-nothing, but rather someone observant. Give yourself a round of applause.

Listen, although we keep saying we're "monitoring her secretly," I feel like she already knows about us—it's just that she chooses to ignore it.

I don't understand why we are monitoring someone like her. Although our first encounter had some misunderstandings, that was entirely caused by cultists, and had nothing to do with her personally.

Besides, her relationship with the students—especially the Keeper—is like a grandmother buying candy for her grandchild! Surely nobody constantly suspects their own grandmother of planning to sacrifice them to cultists... Well, actually, maybe somewhere that really is the case—but that's not important!

What matters is, if she truly has ulterior motives, I guarantee whatever she intends to do has already begun unnoticed, long before the Committee slowly drags out its ridiculous countermeasures.

Phew, feels good to vent. Anyway, I've decided to remove her from this list before the Committee does something unforgivable to her.

And once those bastards really piss her off—I promise it won't just be two buildings destroyed next time. I hope I'm dead by then, or else I'll probably die a very painful death.

If you're the one who will be watching her next, remember—not any rash actions. If you don't like her, just treat her like a mercenary hired to handle dirty work for the school. Unless she clearly shows signs of instability, under no circumstances should you provoke direct confrontation!

Of course, if you want a little gift... I doubt she'll mind that you once monitored her. Go ahead and ask boldly. Honestly, the snacks in her pockets are actually pretty tasty.

—Karapolis Trak, your fellow friend who curses the Committee alongside you.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
■File Number: DIOL-A3-27
■Awakener Code Name: ■■■■

Based on the behavior patterns, decision-making style, and attitude toward various tasks of this Awakener (hereinafter referred to as Kathigu-Ra), investigators conducted relevant speculations and later launched detailed investigations. The following content is now being synchronized:
Kathigu-Ra is an orphan from Region @2; their parents abandoned them during early childhood.

Kathigu-Ra survived in that region by unknown means and took in many unfortunate children. It should be noted that this process involved extensive use of bloody and violent methods. In one well-documented case, the subject brutally murdered all family members of one of the individuals they had taken in.

For a long time afterward, Kathigu-Ra and their subordinates mainly earned income through secretive commissions such as gangland killings, factional conflicts, looting stolen goods, and other black-on-black criminal activities.

According to local testimonies and combined with data from that area, it has been preliminarily inferred that there was a specific point in time when a group centered around Kathigu-Ra and the children they had taken in successfully consolidated control over the majority of the region's criminal organizations.

Currently, we still cannot determine exactly how Kathigu-Ra became an Awakener, but the timeframe aligns with the destruction of the Lantern Church outpost in that area. Given Kathigu-Ra's evident disdain for the Church of the Lightbearers, it is reasonably speculated that their transformation into an Awakener may have been connected to the Church.

According to incomplete statistics, up to now, Kathigu-Ra has destroyed 43 Lantern Church outposts, including 7 major outposts, 12 divine-summoning altars, and 17 research facilities.

Based on the above investigation report and the daily behavioral patterns of this Awakener, the Committee, under the proposal of Honorary Chairman K. Trak, has re-evaluated the threat level posed by Kathigu-Ra. The evaluation results are recorded as follows:
After deliberation by all committee members, this Awakener poses no direct or indirect threat to Mythag. Provided the current cooperation treaty remains unchanged, no intervention regarding its existence or actions is necessary.

Therefore, it is hereby decided that Kathigu-Ra shall be removed from DIOL, and all related investigation activities shall be suspended immediately. All file records shall be fully sealed, and no personnel below Ω clearance are permitted access.

Recorder: K. Trak
(Small handwriting at the bottom of the document)

Congratulations! Finally managed to get those overly cautious fools to cancel this damned project. Not bad for all the time I wasted pushing things forward.

This concludes the final record concerning Lady Kathigu-Ra. Unless something unexpected occurs, no further documentation will be added under this file number. So whoever you are, feel free to close this cursed folder now, step outside for some fresh air, and focus your attention on more deserving subjects!

— Karapolis Trak, your good friend who has become a member of the idle class.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
(Small text at the beginning of the file)

Damn it, how did you find this file? I clearly forbade anyone from accessing it... Well, since you're able to see this file, it means your clearance is far above mine, which indicates you're one of Them, so naturally I have no authority to stop you from knowing these things.

However, please keep in mind, this file should not exist anywhere. The following content is not any formal investigation, but rather an unofficial product composed by myself through secondary inferences based on certain real situations.

I must seriously remind you that the process of compiling this file contains a large amount of investigative methods that cannot be described in detail, subjective assumptions from personal thinking, and even acts of accepting bribes from investigated subjects. If you are not bothered by my aforementioned actions, please continue reading. I guarantee with my reputation that the following content is undeniably authentic.

■Subject Number: ■■■■-A■■-SSS
■Awakener Codename: Lord of Combustion
"Honestly, I don't really like fighting."

I was quite surprised to hear such an answer, considering in all the reports, investigators would use words like "madness," "joy," and "elation" when describing her in combat.

I originally thought her attitude toward fighting was "not initiating, not hating, not refusing," never expecting her to actually feel disgusted by the act itself.

As the conversation continued deeper, I gradually began to understand certain things. When I asked if I could record these words, Kathigu-Ra generously gave me permission to do so.

"You must understand, for most people in this world, simply being alive is already a luxury."

I expressed agreement with this statement. Although most people I've encountered live comfortable lives—I could even go to the biggest opera house in Lentienni anytime I wanted—I clearly know the hidden truth of this world, and how many people are carrying burdens behind my comfortable life.

"Therefore, in many cases, intense fighting spirit is the price you pay to stay alive."

"We don't get to choose how we live. Once you step into the mud, it's nearly impossible to pull yourself out again."

I originally wanted to argue against this viewpoint, but upon carefully recalling several cases, I found they were all people who could hardly be considered ordinary. As for those nameless nobodies, they mostly only exist within the memoirs of others.

"Perhaps some naive person might say, if that's the case, then why not just not do it from the beginning? That idea sounds good. I once carved it onto a certain tombstone to commemorate someone who strictly followed that principle."

"To protect everyone in this cruel world, I must appear strong and mad enough to make the ever-present malice hesitate."

"Of course, those emotions I display during battle are not fake. I truly enjoy the sensations battle brings me."

"It might be a bit hard to understand, but it's like how you might enjoy the content of your job, but not the act of working itself."

Upon hearing this explanation, I immediately understood her meaning. Indeed, I really enjoy prying into others' privacy to satisfy my own guilty curiosity, but that doesn't mean I enjoy having to drag myself out of bed at eight o'clock every morning and follow orders to stay somewhere the entire day.

"When I was first abandoned, I was just like many other girls—lost, hesitant, and clueless."

"I hoped to receive help from others, but the world gave me nothing but countless betrayals and pains."

"Gradually, I began using cruelty and madness to forge armor against malice, adapting to everything in this world like drinking poison to quench thirst."

"Until finally, they melted within the ceaseless flames, merging with my flesh and blood."

As if to prove her words just now, Kathigu-Ra suddenly gave me an extremely cruel, evil, and mad smile, so much that I spilled the pale yellow liquid in my cup all over myself.

Oh, maybe it's a good thing, because this way, if I ever lose muscle control and accidentally spill something, I can naturally explain it as just the drink I spilled earlier.

In the end, Kathigu-Ra never directly answered my question, but I think my previous judgment was correct—she simply shouldn't exist within DIOL.

—Recorder Karapolis Trak

"My original wish was simply to have a home."

"A home without betrayal, without pain, filled with laughter and joy."

"Unfortunately, I didn't understand until that day."

"This was the most luxurious delusion in this cruel world."

—Kathigu-Ra

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Those unnamable things slither in the dark, gnawing at the edges of the world. Sooner or later, you'll have to face them. But don't worry, I've got your back. Always.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I see clearer now. I see what writhes beneath the abyss... I, We, require more power. For you. For my family. I must...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Looking for salvation in this ugly world? Keep at it, hopeful little one.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: After a good hunt comes a good feast. Here, try my roasted camel and fresh tequila. What? You're not good with liquor? Fine, well, have some juice instead.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Here, you can have these. Forbidden relics from some ruins. Was gonna burn them, but figured you might get some use. How'd I get my hands on these? Let's just say some folks <Italic:voluntarily> handed 'em over. And don't worry, source is clean.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Don't push yourself too hard, Keeper. I know it's rough out there, and one wrong step means disaster. But if you keep this up, you'll break. Come find me when you need someone to talk to. We're family.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
Come here. Sit closer. No need to be so stiff. 
Funny, isn't it? When we first met, I never thought I could let my guard down like this. Ha, the mighty Living Flame, yearning for a family she could fully trust.
Now, promise me something. When the day comes... when you can't hold on any longer— speak My name. And I, We, shall come. We shall take you into Our Kingdom. It may only delay the inevitable... but in your final moments, you will rest, cradled in Our embrace.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: What's wrong, little one? Need a hug? Come here. Big sis has got you... Haha, don't be shy.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: What do I think of Dissolution? Ask a sewer rat what it thinks of the king. My answer is simple: a deep, instinctual disgust. Give me the chance, and I'll pour a glass of camel milk wine and listen to their scream as my guns burns them to ashes.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: I only come when there's work. Need me? Say the words. Come on, repeat after me: ...@4...@2Ia! Kathigu-Ra!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Burn and Destruction are my everything, I'm obsessed with the death that comes from hunting... Do you really think I'd say something like that? Haha. I only ever cared about my family... Even more than myself.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Those sick bastards playing with human lives in the dark? Yeah. I'll kill 'em all. Every last one.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You're my family. And I'm damn proud of you. So stand tall, my %player%! No matter what, I've got your back.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About N
voiceLines.content: I'll find Him. Doesn't matter where in this rotten universe He's hiding. That filthy rat's gonna pay. Every last bit of His "rapture and delight" will burn in hellfire. Rest assured, I'll save you a premium seat at His funeral... so we can savor His final screams together.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Thais
voiceLines.content: The legendary Queen of Aram, the Great Aeon of Desire, Tifere Yesod... I saw her once, when I was hunting N down. Don't agree with her methods, but... if it was the only way to protect my family from "Its" gaze... I'd have done the same. We are not so different, her and me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Guns
voiceLines.content: You know, these guns don't fire bullets. They shoot desire and malice. Seven shots, and everything burns. These chaotic flames, resembling flesh, will drag everything into the inferno.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Family
voiceLines.content: Back in that shithole town, we survived by being meaner than the rest. Even after clawing our way up, we had to watch our backs—lords, guards, those damn "noble knights" clinging to the past. Now's different. They are my family. My Kynde. No more bowing. Just one little stray left out there... but that one? That one's gonna be just fine. Always took care of the rest for me while I'm away.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content: Shh... Don't be afraid. It's just the sound of rats decaying in the damp cellar. From the deepest abyss, a crimson desire festers. The imprisoned soul yearns for blood, just as the blind long for light and the lecherous thirst for flesh. And the way to please her is quite simple: lash out at her and humiliate her to your heart's content.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
...

Experiment Date: @2, A.F.@1
Experiment Objective: Observe and record mutational responses of a Dissolution patient following tissue and organ grafting.

Experiment Steps: @3 @4
The experiment was conducted on the subject using tissues and organs sourced from her deceased brother, in order to observe the rejection response between first-degree relatives. The poor wretch was shot dead while evading police capture. @3 experiment was highly successful; the wound turned red and sprouted tentacles... with blood spurting out like liquid rubies.

@3 @3
The subject demonstrated remarkable endurance, refusing morphine injections.

Post-experiment, her bloodlust intensified, and her temperament became... indescribable, not a type I am adept at handling.

—Excerpt from Herbert's <Italic:Dissolution Experiment Records, Group4, No. @1>

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
It is an unspoken rule among the students: keep your distance from the library basement, the cemetery, and Leigh.

The pale and frail girl enjoys provoking others and then savoring their anger with quiet pleasure. Like the serpent of Eden, she knows precisely when to cast her whispered temptation: <Italic:Hurt me... Come on...>
Most of the time, she is met with nothing but eye-rolls, confusion, and curses. Only once did she finally get what she wanted—Uvhash beat her up without hesitation, and even knocked out one of her teeth. He is a man utterly devoid of curiosity about others; you asked for it, you got it—simple as that.

As the warrior strode away into the distance, a smile of pure contentment bloomed on Leigh's face. The soft morning light washed over her—it was another beautiful, sunny day.

<Italic:I still have plenty of teeth; take them all... Anyone, please, just take them all...>

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
@1, A.F.@2
Dear Lord Cavendish,

Please forgive me. I took the liberty of asking Butler Frey to bring me ink and paper. I am struggling to maintain my last shred of sanity and dignity as I write this letter. Since I fell ill with this horrible disease, I haven’t been able to see Mother, Bobby, or you. Missing you all is enough to drive me crazy.

I have been locked in this basement for... 353 days? I don't know. Maybe 326 days.

It's freezing here, and everything smells like it's rotting. My wounds are oozing black slime, and the rats have gnawed them beyond recognition. But it's okay. Pain is a good thing; it keeps my mind clear.

"An evil vampire," "a disgrace to the family"... locking me away was undoubtedly a wise decision. My soul has long been controlled by the devil. As I write this letter, I have just drained the blood of a deceased homeless man. Butler Frey said you had people find him on the street. Although the blood tasted a bit spoiled, I'm still glad to know that you care about me.

Also... could you give me a blanket? I have no clothes to cover myself now, and winter in Londinium is just too cold.

Even now, I still really miss the time when we were kids, spending our holidays together at Whelton House.

Your sincere sister,
Leigh
—Excerpt from <Italic: The Cansington Vampire Incident—Case Summary: Evidence C-601>

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
The smell of rust spread through the air.

<Italic:That is... the smell of "food.">
The girl slowly opened her eyes. Her mind was a complete blur after being injected with large doses of sedatives for so long. Lying in front of her was a beagle with its throat torn out—<Italic:Bambi>, she thought. <Italic:Or was it Bobby?>
Just as the girl was lost in memories, a sharp pain shot through her abdomen—she was attacked by her "food". The bound vagrant before her trembled violently, seemingly screaming at the top of his lungs.

"Vampire! Monster... monster!!"

Yet, the girl heard none of it. She only stared blankly, gently touching the blood on her abdomen.

A large amount of warm blood poured from the wound like slippery satin, joyfully spreading across the floor.

So, she could still feel pain. She could still bleed.

Tears slid silently down her face. She reached out with her thin, blood-stained hands, and gently cupped her prey's face.

"Next time... could you please try a little harder?"

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Yearning for an entity she calls "Mommy", this girl obediently follows the commands of her "Master".

Her true name lost to the world, she is now known only by the form she inhabits: a delicate white filament, reminiscent of a lily, blooming at the center of a giant black eyeball made of sludge. Hence, they named her Lily.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
When Erica tried to pull the records on Lily Oswood, she returned eighty-one error alerts. Lily was forgotten by the world once; her birth certificate and her medical files have all rotted into a handful of black silt.
We can still observe the shape of her Silvercore with specialized instruments: fine and curling, like several strands of hair twisted together—more precisely, like an infant's downy hair.
One point deserves particular attention. Lily always shows an unusual attachment to her Linker. Presenting yourself as her "mother," rather than as a "companion" or a "master," will likely bring you close to her much faster.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
The aftereffects of an incomplete Awakening, along with the psychological shock of being handed to a new Linker, have left Lily's personality and mind noticeably regressed. Everyone on campus has noticed how little she speaks.
Apart from trailing after the Keeper and the Awakener Lotan, Lily is almost never seen around the university on her own. She doesn't come to class, and she doesn't join the younger Awakeners' games. When she isn't deployed, she simply waits in her dorm, quietly, for orders.
Her window looks straight out onto the Keygrave behind the campus. At sunset she stands there, staring out at the graves under that dull yellow light.
The silver-key headstones draw long, thin shadows in the low sun, and Lily at the window is every bit as silent as they are.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
"Mommy, Mommy, I didn't cry when I got the shot!"

"You're so brave!"

"Because I knew Mommy was coming back! It didn't hurt at all!"

...

"Master, give me an order."

"Lie down on the operating table; the operation will start in fifteen minutes. Did you take your medicine on time?"

"I did, Master."

"I'll cut you here.  It doesn't hurt, right?"

"... It doesn't hurt, Master."

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Better if she had never woken at all. Those who have sunk into the abyss were never meant to open their eyes to the blazing sun.
She was supposed to be numb experimental material, someone the world had already buried—no capacity for pain, no hunger to be loved.
Her mother could not let her go, and that made a tragedy of her entire life. Lily is still lost in the same question: whether she ought to submit to what the world has arranged for her.
Perhaps one day someone who defies fate will give her the answer.

storySections.title: Story: V
storySections.content:
The small soul, which should have been lost to the river of history, relied on her mother's wish, the abundant spiritual energy from establishing the magic circle with @1@2@1, and the fusion with the giant creature frozen beneath Elworth, resurrecting as the monster "Lily".

Due to incomplete awakening, Lily at the beginning had no consciousness, merely a combat doll that obeyed orders.

Francis Oswood, a member of the Sculptors' Association, used Lily as a prototype to conduct illegal experiments lasting @2 years. From Francis's diary, it was known that Lily's state back then was extremely unstable, often going out of control and causing localized destruction, which forced Francis to frequently change residences.

With the intake of the gnosis elixir and the implantation of the silver chip, Lily regained her perception and some memories on an undocumented day. After some twists and turns, Francis took over the almost bankrupt Lai Hospital and transformed it into a testing ground.

During the "Hellhound" incident in Lai Town No. L-776, her mother, Francis Oswood, was trapped in her self-created anomalous dimension and lost contact.

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content: She dances within the embrace of green flames, their dim flickering light falling across the dancer's young, devotion-filled face. With every turn, the emerald fire ignites the souls of the wicked, burning away every impurity upon the stage.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
A.F. 31@1, December, the police received a report from the manager of the second theater in @2 Garden. The reporter claimed that there had been four small-scale fires in the theater within a week, and rumors of the "Ballet Ghost" were rampant among the members of the dance troupe renting the theater.

To ensure the smooth premiere of the ballet "Swan's Lament," the police launched a joint investigation with the West District Fire Department.

The day before the performance, Mythag University finally took over the investigation. The investigators noted traces of Gnosis residue behind several fire points. Eventually, Investigator @3 discovered an Awakener in the underground ruins of the second theater.

This Awakener was not a mindless individual; she identified herself as "Liz." After communication, the Awakener Liz eventually admitted to her arson crime. After the premiere of "Swan's Lament," Investigator @3 took Liz back to Mythag University for formal incorporation.

According to historical records, when the fire broke out at the second theater in @2 Garden on A.F. 29@1, a ballet was being performed. Among those who perished in the flames were a number of nobles in the audience, as well as a young prima ballerina named "Elizabeth Sur."

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Liz is a reliable Awakener; although her attitude cannot be called "enthusiastic", she shows considerable cooperation with all school affairs.

The only concern is that, though Liz spends every night in the dance classroom, no one has seen her true dance performance.

As an excellent ballet dancer, Liz's name has appeared in several related publications. Unfortunately, due to the impact of the D-phenomenon, the information department of the awakening system could only determine that Liz had stepped onto the stage of the second theater in A.F. 29@1.

School reporter Hannah Peasley proposed gathering dance enthusiasts on campus, using their passion for dance to "open Awakener Liz's heart".

Currently, this proposal has yet to be approved by the Awakener Management Office.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Day 45 of joining the dance troupe. I stood on stage as the lead performer.

The scorching lights struck the hem of my skirt, and the tiny diamonds scattered a dazzling brilliance across the air. The glare made it hard to see, but the thunderous applause told me that my performance shone brighter than any gem.

In endless spinning, all the dust of the world is purified by the dance, and the beauty of art is carried out to every corner. This is my wish and my mission as a dancer—

But who are those people lurking in the dark corners beneath the stage?

Lisette, the girl known for her carefree and upright nature—why is she whispering with that notorious lord?

Angelica, the genius who always looks down on the other dancers—why is she lifting her skirt for that infamous playboy?

Such disgrace... such filth! Oh God, my muse, tell me—what must I do to guard my stage from the darkness? What light is needed to dispel this filth—

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
This is the Promised Land, an artistic utopia, the ultimate paradise—dance should be the dancer's home, kept in eternal purity.

So long as I burn, filth cannot taint our Church... This is my mission, my hope... Let me burn brightly, and I shall cleanse away all impurity, for everyone.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: You provided me with a place to stay, and I am grateful. But forgive me, I no longer deserve to stand upon the stage again.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Keep improving your composure.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Are my movements accurate enough?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Fouette. Twenty more times.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: This reminds me of the first pair of red dancing shoes I received when I was eight. I really love them. Thank you, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Close your eyes and tell me, what do you see? Immaculate moonlight, a tranquil lake...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Even if my heart holds no more longing, I will still play the role of the swan.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: It is the yearning for life that drives the swan to struggle for its return to the distant sky.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: No matter how you struggle, you cannot defy fate. But that fleeting moment of brilliance will be frozen into eternity.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I will include your name in my acknowledgments. It is you who allowed these feet, tainted by dark blood, to step into the wonderful world of ballet once more. From now on, please watch me dance, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Do you want me to take the stage and shine? That's impossible now. These eyes have been consumed by hatred. All I can do is burn everything to ashes.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Do you understand that feeling? Spinning, spinning, spinning, never stopping. Knees stretched to the limit, toes bleeding black, soaking the ballet shoes, yet never pausing. All because I refuse to accept the fate of being a mere toy...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I didn't burn skilled court dancers, graceful ballet masters, or nobles who appreciate beauty. I burned useless fools selling their bodies, sycophants disregarding others, and filthy beings lost in lust... You understand me, right?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: The devout dancer is dead, and the blasphemer of art is also dead, both perished in flames filled with the scent of tar. Death is not the end but the beginning, for only humans die; dance and art are eternal.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Thank you for your understanding. Perhaps now is the time to reconcile with my past self... I believe I am doing the right thing and have not disgraced my family's legacy in dance. I will step onto the stage you have prepared and shine as you wish.

voiceLines.content: Dance is pure. Words may lead to misunderstandings, but dance steps never do.

voiceLines.content: Tinct... Hearing her mournful song makes me want to dance...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Lotan has so many labels attached to her that no one knows how to approach this black-clad swordswoman.

Too humble and she will shatter your knees for being too boring; too arrogant and she will slash your insolence with her greatsword; too tough and she will soften your soul through battle.

But perhaps this is the arrogance befitting one born with the planet itself. As a former guardian, she has every right to her arrogance.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
In A.F. 180, as the Northern Hemisphere suffered a severe drought, the Korasuyu River ceased to flow.

Local residents unearthed a monstrous skeleton from the riverbed's silt. Since the Korasuyu River signifies "turbid water" in local culture, the skeleton was named the "Bone of Chaos."

Marine biologists identified it as the skeleton of a humpback whale, approximately 32 feet long and entirely covered in a silvery substance. The following year, this skeleton was auctioned at the Aethis auction house for 130 million Leonian Florins.

The auction house refused to disclose the true identity of the buyer, but rumors suggest that the skeleton was transported to a private university on the outskirts of Londinium.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
At Mythag University, the campus legend that "preparatory students must fight Lotan to become investigators" has spiraled out of control, driving fear of the black-clad swordswoman to an all-time high. Many students who specialize in theoretical research break into a cold sweat at the mere sight of a black hemline, dreading any chance of locking eyes with the "battle maniac" and meeting their end on the training ground.

In a brief exclusive interview conducted by Editor-in-Chief Hannah Peaslee, Miss Lotan offered the following remarks:
"I don't have time to play house with babies."

"Weaklings have no place being my opponent—are you one of them? Or do you have the nerve to face Chaos head-on?"

—As of press time, the editor-in-chief has not left her dormitory. This issue of the <Italic:Mythag Daily> was printed and distributed by intern editor Howard.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Lotan has her own criteria when it comes to choosing worthy opponents.

She finds academic warriors tiresome; most have read themselves into a stupor, their heads filled with nothing but theoretical maneuvers that fail on the field.

Military standouts, meanwhile, are too shackled by red tape and moral dogma to offer any real thrill.

Only those rare geniuses—blessed with raw talent and an innate instinct for slaughter—can earn her favor.

A primordial beast, as old as the planet itself, kept her thirst for battle in check and waited with near-religious patience for her chosen opponent to reach his zenith. What a gifted youth he was—commanding power from the abyssal deep, his formidable spirit capable of bridging even the Outer Gods. Given time, he would surely have grown into a warrior worthy of her blade.

But perhaps the vast stretches of time had dulled her judgment. This time, the Spirit of Chaos misjudged her mark. As for the details, Lotan refuses to speak of it to anyone.

All we know is that since then, she has held nothing but utter contempt for those who lack ambition or wallow in mediocrity.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Born from Chaos, she embodies pure chaotic power, an untamed free spirit, and an undefined order.

She craves challenges and battles; only by unleashing her irrepressible destructive urge can she fulfill her creator's sole wish.

—To safeguard this planet until the end. She has yearned for a truly exhilarating battle for far too long.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Interesting. Your growth in battle far surpasses my expectations. Given time, you might become... Strange. Even after all this time, I still find hope in a creature as seemingly weak as you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Perhaps now is the time. Listen closely. Lotan, the Beast of the Stars, formally challenges you. Do not fret; I shall ensure your survival until you reach your zenith. I will not allow my chosen opponent to suffer the same fate again.

voiceLines.content: My duties extend beyond fighting. Even in the Archean Eon, I had more to do than sit idly by... Hey, don't tell me you think I'm just some brute who only knows how to swing a sword?!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Ramona is the only one here worth my time. She's quite gifted with a blade. The rest are so rigid and boring... Are you like them? Do you actually enjoy writing those tedious mission reports?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Black veils, and beneath the robes Miryam's body, worn down to the bone.
She makes no sound. Devotion and grief are woven together in her face, like a Madonna in a mural, heavy with a mystery no one can read.
Everything she has, she pours into waiting for one particular moment.
It is close now. The appointed day is almost here...

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
The rumors of humans landing in the polar regions have intensified this century. In response, Mythag University and the Mystia Treaty Committee have collaborated to form a joint investigation team.

In December of A.F. 3@1, the joint investigation team ventured deep into the Elworth ice fields with the aim of recovering potential mystical artifacts before the arrival of secular expedition teams.

......

On December 10, A.F. 3@1, Investigator Johansson accidentally fell into an ice cave, discovering a hollow space beneath the ice field. The altitude is too low; the melting ice will submerge the hollow within three days. We must complete our exploration before temperatures continue to rise.

On December 12, A.F. 3@1, there are reasons to believe that a cult has long used the hollow as a sacrificial pit. At the bottom of the cave, we discovered countless humanoid skeletons. Yes, humanoid—with cartilaginous fins connected to their skulls.

......

On December 13, A.F. 3@1, damn, damn, damn, damn! At the peak of the bone mountain, the investigator discovered the recent remains of a human!!!

The cult may not have yet withdrawn from the polar region. Due to the Committee's foolish "persistence," no Awakener investigators were permitted to accompany us. We must leave immediately!

——"Motion on Blockading the Wild Sea Route: Part One"

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Miryam leads a plain, ascetic life on campus. Solitude, contemplation, silent prayer, cleaning, labor—the same round, day after day.
The awe and wariness of others, the gossip, the curiosity: she meets it all with indifference. On a campus far from her homeland, she seems to have found a new form of spiritual discipline.
In truth, she does not mind talking at all. Spare her a little of your time and she will tell you of the greatness of that immortal god, of the distant civilization that stood before history and the eternal kingdom its wise young king ruled. Whenever she speaks of it, her eyes fill with a pity her listeners have never seen before.
Worth noting: Miryam holds an unusual devotion and reverence toward Tulu, though Tulu has never treated her as anything special.
If you ever need to negotiate with Miryam, asking Tulu for help may turn things in your favor.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
She was born before human history was written, in an old civilization no record can confirm today.
There, the children of the stars raised glorious kingdoms and temples to an immortal god. She grew up inside that faith, devout from childhood, set on becoming an apostle of the divine.
But a god's calling is not so easily won. She hungered for miracles and visions, and not once did she see them.
Not until Tulu took the throne, and her diligence at last lifted her to High Priestess—the moment she would never forget, when a deep, reeling joy flooded her soul and set her spirit trembling.
At last she had seen a miracle; at last she understood the truth of it. This young king was the very thing she had hungered for: the immortal made flesh among mortals.
Years later the great flood came and drowned the civilization. She heard from Tulu the last prophecy of the immortal, then returned to the temple and prayed until the final moment.
Ages came and went, seas turned to land, a new humanity spread across the earth, and no one remembered anything from before.
And from there, Miryam's trial had only just begun.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Those who have never been called are pitiable, for they cannot grasp what immortality truly means. Worldly strife is meaningless, a shallow diversion along the way.
I have looked upon it. I have tasted it. I have long known what this body is for.
And yet, and yet... how cruel fate is! Why did You... not choose Your most faithful priestess again?
—No. You are setting me a trial. You are testing my faith. In the place furthest from my homeland, in all the hours without Your grace, my faith has passed through ten thousand years and never changed.
I was not the one who welcomed Your rebirth, but I have prepared everything for it. I will find You another eternal realm... The bitterness and the honor are both mine, and I must carry this duty alone...
Forgive my ugly envy. If I may look upon Your majesty once more, if I may raise Your kingdom again, there is nothing I would not do.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: A mere drop in the tides, a shallow follower of the immortal, Miryam... greets you.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Have you acknowledged my wish?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Closer... ever closer to my lord...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: I shall not forget what you've contributed for my reunion with Him...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: I have been called; the line between god and supplicant now bleeds.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Bathed in such sacred radiance... Is this the divine power He holds? So boundless... so sublime...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Brighter... and clearer...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: The gate to His realm is almost within reach.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: May He guide me into His sanctuary, where His serenity covers my dreams...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I have been wholly restored as an Awakener... Now the Divine Realm's chorus resonates within me...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: The ecstasy of being illuminated by His glory is beyond your faithless comprehension... May He, in His mercy, forgive your blindness and impudence.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: We are all wretched mortals in the dust, but the Sage walks apart. He is the Emissary, a divine incarnation. His counsel echoes with the voices of gods, steering our frail civilization toward immortality... I do not expect your hollow mind to grasp devotion now, but one day, you too shall kneel before His throne.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: The Chosen are blessed indeed, don't you agree? Their flesh has been remade by His holy will, their lives extended beyond mortal measure. When He strides upon the shore, they will rise as His choir. Isn't this the utmost sweetness and highest happiness for mortals frail as sands?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Perhaps I was too hasty to dismiss you as merely mortal. How does one untouched by grace still cling to purpose? This is Miryam's curiosity, not a question from the Holy Mother of the Seas. Will you... indulge me?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: How could one as extraordinary as you not tire of this transient, tumultuous world? You shall find your rightful home in the eternal realm. There, your feet will kiss the hallowed ground, your breaths will be renewed in sacred waters, and your soul will flourish in blessed earth... You will join me in this holy pilgrimage. Join me in this holy pilgrimage. Together we'll rise far beyond mortal bounds, till we stand united at the Throne, and taste the ripened joy in its light...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: This shell should not stir for anyone but Him... And yet... your warmth...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Past
voiceLines.content: I am no one of consequence, merely one devoted soul among countless. I have dedicated my life to that magnificent presence, and I shall never cease to offer my all to earn but a glance.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Goliath

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Strictly speaking, she does not belong to this world on the brink of collapse, but she appreciates it.

She admires the magnificent spectacle of this world burning, appreciates the suffering and breakdown of these humans in despair.

Faith is dead, society has come to a halt, morals have crumbled, and nature no longer needs to disguise itself as a boring "normal person" —
she can finally unleash the beast within her and reveal her true self, becoming her authentic self.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
On January 17, A.F.3, after receiving the notification of the review meeting regarding the human sacrifice held by the Sect of Astral Dawn in region @4, I immediately set out to investigate the area.

By the time I arrived, it was already evening, and the area was shrouded in thick fog for unknown reasons, making visibility nearly impossible.

I did not carry any devices to disperse the fog, but considering the seriousness of the situation, I rushed into the mist anyway. If time could rewind, I would never have made such a reckless move, because, because there were terrifying @2 in the fog...

When those indescribable, twisted beings attacked me at inhuman speed, I couldn't react at all. My body went rigid, unable to move.

But ultimately, I did not die. That girl, the enigmatic girl from the fog, saved me.

She may have shouted "Tornado"? I didn't catch it clearly; I only saw an axe flying out of the fog, cleaving the head of that terrifying creature. Then the girl took the axe and slung it over her shoulder.

"It's very dangerous in the fog; if you don't want to die, leave this place."

As she said this, her expression was smiling, a sweet smile of a young girl, but for some reason, I found that smile even more chilling than the monsters in the fog.

A human, or rather something with a human form, traversing through the mist filled with monsters, yet remaining unscathed while maintaining that "sweet" smile...

In fear, I finally got up and screamed, distancing myself from her.

Soon, the thick fog occupied my line of sight, and I fell into a state where I could see nothing again. But her laughter, her innocent, youthful laughter, kept echoing in the fog.

— "File: Investigation of the Sect of Astral Dawn in Region @4"

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
In the eyes of most students, Mouchette is definitely the most suitable person to be friends with. She always wears a smile, enthusiastically engages in conversations, and is unlikely to refuse any requests made to her, which is why she often gets invited to go shopping, chat, or eat.

But only a few know her true nature. In front of these people, she no longer has to pretend to be friendly or hide her contempt for rules and order.

"What friends? Just a way to pass the time out of boredom. If I don't do this, I'll be seen as a problem student and taken to see Principal Kellett for questioning—what a hassle."

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Her life seemed to always be full of surprises: first, she encountered the rampant unknown fog, and then she was inexplicably summoned to another world.

When the summoning ritual was completed and she first set foot on the land of this other world, Mouchette saw the familiar thick fog, and within it, the screams of people.

Those were the sacrifices fleeing from the cultists.

Sacrifices? Cultists? What... exciting and fresh vocabulary.

This represented a new world, running a jungle game of survival of the fittest, and coincidentally, she had never been the weak one.

Calmly, she hunted the cultists in the fog, happily even humming a tune.

"One by one, and again... in the unknown fog, I vent freely ♪"

"Knock open your skull, delve into your brain, let's pass the time in this chase ♪"

Amidst this casual humming, Mouchette sensed the hollow hunger within her—
this mad world could not fill the void in her heart, but it could alleviate her soul's hunger for destruction and madness.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
One day, she will return to her own world.

But before that, she wants to see the conclusion of this world—

Will the one known as the "Keeper" be consumed by this chaotic and terrifying world, or will they shine brightly, bringing true redemption and light to this crumbling world?

This is a mystery, a challenge, a gamble.

And she wants to know the answer.

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Proud, willful, self-centered... Many who have interacted with her would describe her personality as such. She seems to have always been treated like the center of the universe in her last living arrangement; perhaps it was this meticulous care that cultivated her spoiled nature.

"Hey! What are you looking at? Didn't I say that if I call you three times, you have to respond to this young lady?!"

—One must be very careful, even when reading the documents.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
In the summer of 3@2 A.F., stories of a sea monster began going around Niugini Island.
Fishermen claimed they had sighted a cephalopod some five stories tall in the coastal waters. Deep red all over, with black concentric rings along its tentacles.
When the rumor reached me, Johansen and I were verifying a suspected Dissolution Phenomenon in the Medan region. The next day he had a ship ready for Niugini Island. I am writing this report in the middle of the Amirante Ocean.
Day three of the voyage: dead fish across the surface in great drifts—mackerel, flounder, dolphins. I swear there was a pregnant sperm whale among them. The old hands all say overbreeding starves the water of oxygen and that is what kills them, but I can't shake the feeling that we are missing something...
Day eight: my seasickness is far worse, and the nausea is bad enough that I can hardly eat. We were close to Niugini Island, but Johansen insisted we turn back @3... I don't understand it, but I have chosen to trust him.
—Bell Columbus, "Internship Report, Summer of 3@2 A.F."

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Now that she has been Awakened, we finally know what sort of life Murphy led in the Order.
A parasol always in hand, and a great deal of time spent on her appearance before she will step outside. Afternoon tea at four, milk tea with scones and strawberry jam. Neat, elegant—a lady's calling, as she sees it, and wherever she happens to be, she insists on living like one.
(Archivist's note: I'd argue the way she grabs beef suet pudding in her bare hands is not especially ladylike...)
There are no servants left for her to order about now, yet she still lives exactly as she wishes, and that is genuinely good to see.
Because of what happened, she has almost nothing to do with the Awakeners Miryam and Goliath—she will look straight through them on purpose. When she meets the Awakener Tulu, her face becomes very difficult to read.
Bring up the past and her temper turns foul. Perhaps she still needs a little time to settle.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
"You are a being charged with a glorious mission. You are the hope of Its return to this world."
"Be a good girl. Do as you're told... When It wakes again, every one of us will live in an undying kingdom."
A hidden daughter whose very birth could not be made public became, for reasons of their own, the treasure of the Sea-Treading High Priest. A pitiful infant no one had cared about was transformed into a Divine Maiden whose fate was bound to a mysterious civilization.
The ascetic Holy Mother raised her with her own hands. Offering and worship surrounded her from her earliest years, and anything she wanted, someone would present to her with both hands.
Had the Dissolution Phenomenon never appeared, had the vessel of the "god" never begun to fail, she would simply have taken up the High Priest's mantle in time and stood above the faithful, exactly as arranged.
But one day everything she had been given came to collect: a fate she had never once wished for had long since decided an ending she could not refuse.
To be the mother of a god, to bear the child of prophecy—the Divine Maiden's glorious sacrifice meant nothing more than handing over her body and her life, gladly.
From the day a second heart began beating in her chest, her soul was a river in flood, bound to be lost in time.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
The haughtiness, the way she looks through everyone, is only armor, and bluff at that. Under the fine dress is a rebel's heart no one knows about.
Shut inside a lovely cage built out of sacred storytelling, Murphy knows better than anyone how false people are, and how false gods are. When the faithful look at her, there is nothing in their eyes but fear and pity; what her "Caregiver" calls love is the care one gives an offering. Her mission ends not in glory but in her own death—she knows the ending, so how could she lose herself in the distant kingdom the doctrine paints?
The plan to manufacture a god, the return of the old king, so many impossible hopes heaped upon her—and not once did anyone ask whether she was willing to die for a future no one could promise.
The canary will not spend her whole life in the cage, so she beats her wings at the thorn hedge. Having wagered her life on breaking free of fate, she means to choose the direction of her flight herself.
"My name is Murphy... and don't imagine you can give me orders! I know perfectly well what I should do and what I shouldn't."

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Ugh, isn't this annoying? Stop pestering me about that! ...Fine, do what you want. It's just a way to kill time, after all.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Stop! This is a robbery! I suggest you be sensible and hand over all your candy, or else... Hmph.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: What? You actually expect a "thank you" from me?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Those despicable people at Mythag, daring to block my access to candy! See? I still got to have them in the end!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: As a tribute, it is hardly adequate... but seeing your sincerity, I suppose I'll accept it. Just this once.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: How do they get the filling inside? I can't find any seams or pinholes! I wish these candy inventors would join Mythag's staff and invent a new dessert for me every single day!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Did you truly believe this would make me listen to you?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Soft, hard, crunchy, flaky, milky, fruity, nutty, chocolatey... Ah, how can there be so many varieties I haven't tasted yet? I've decided: Mythag must make Halloween a weekly holiday!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Have you reserved the venue? It must be a garden at least 150 square meters!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: You're far more thoughtful than those dreadful waiters—even reserved some candy just for me. Keep up the good work, my exclusive servant.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Brownie, caramel pudding, Sachertorte, chocolate mousse, cookies... All must be served on every single table!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: You still have chocolate? Excellent, give it all to me. What? Your stuff is my stuff; isn't that only natural?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: The tables and chairs must have lace that suits my taste, and the potted plants must be red spider lilies... Now, hurry and get this prepared!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: What? You can roast this kind of marshmallow? But it's gonna get hot and sticky... You sure it tastes good? Let me try... Fine, I'll take a nibble. If you dare to trick me... Huh?! This soft and crispy texture is actually amazing!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Go and invite the guests! Is even this simple task too much for you?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Which candy do I like the most? Let me think... Hazelnut brittle is fragrant, caramel chocolate is delicious, those strawberry and grape-flavored gummies have quite the fun texture, and there's a malt sugar that can be pulled very long and has a beautiful color like honey... No, I refuse to choose. Every candy has its own unique charm! Anyway, I have plenty of pumpkin baskets, so I'll just take them all!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Check my dress for me, quickly! No wrinkles, nothing loose... What? Is there a problem?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: My current life goal is to eat every single candy in the world. Just thinking about the countless kinds of candy waiting for me out there... that is my entire reason for getting out of bed. Cake, you say? Cake is my other life goal.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Welcome to my final Enlightenment Ceremony! All of this was meticulously designed by me. Of course, you contributed... a tiny bit.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Hahaha! Mine, all mine! All of Mythag's candies belong to me! What are you waiting for? Follow me, the great Candy Witch! We're going to conquer every candy shop in Londinium right now!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: You'd better not put on airs with me. Know your place! I call the shots in this room.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Are there really Witches out there? If they live in deserted forests, who handles their cooking, cleaning, and dessert preparation? If you can't even host an afternoon tea, what is the point of that life? I can't even stand the thought of it.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Don't just barge into a lady's room, and do not comment on her demeanor. Leave now, I need to rest.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: If I were a witch, my palace would be the height of luxury, of course. I'd hire ten master chefs to make new cakes and candies for me daily... That would make me a princess, not a witch, you say? So what? I shall be the Princess Witch!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I dislike those slimy tentacles, and I do not like the deep sea... Don't give me that knowing look! I am not a child afraid of my parents!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I heard witches have a mysterious black cat. But that disgusting campus stray is too embarrassing for a fine lady like me. So, it's settled now. Put on this {Male=catboy,Female=catgirl} headband. I'll make you my little black cat.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Living in their illusory dreams, stripped of my right to be normal, without any choice... all for a ridiculous prophecy... I was willing to do anything to escape this life!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: You found a new candy? Let me see... Tsk, this Ring Pop looks so ridiculous! A "diamond" ring the size of an egg? Wait! What do you mean by presenting me with a ring? Explain yourself immediately!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
Was my only option to wait for death? Could anyone help me? Could I truly resist? I asked myself this daily. The answer was in my mind—I just never dared to see it... If you hadn't appeared, I don't know if I'd have the courage to fight back.
Th-Thank you—don't get me wrong, this isn't a confession or anything!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: No more plush lambskin rugs, black pearl necklaces or silk pajamas from the far east... and yet, to wake up every day in a room full of candy, with baskets overflowing... this might be what happiness truly looks like... Hey, wipe that silly smile off your face! If you want to serve me forever, you still have a lot of work to do!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: You want some of my candy? Hmph. I'm feeling generous, so I might bestow a piece upon you... if you beg nicely, that is.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: The world is full of dark, disgusting things. Instead of worrying about its end, you'd be better off using that time to eat some more candy before it happens.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: The rules at Mythag's restaurant are often annoying, but their pastry skills... hmm, they're barely passable, I suppose.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I used to find candy too plain and not elegant enough compared to cake, but now it seems I underestimated these little things in colorful plastic wrappers. They have such a long shelf life! I could hoard as much as I want, I could fill the whole room with them!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Why are you stopping me? As my faithful servant, shouldn't you be actively helping me rob... I mean, acquire all the candy?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Jenkin
