storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
The artist from Cité cares not for other people. She only pursues the absolute form of pure beauty, etching ephemeral moments into eternity.

As her inspiration surges forth, her chisel never ceases; as her works witness completion, her body is submerged in coral-colored shades. In the corner of her workshop which she pays no heed, her agony and delight intertwine, sprouting from her very existence.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
"In the year of A.F.3@2, the Marine Ecology Team of Mythag University discovered an oddly shaped coral reef while conducting species observations in the southern seas...

"Have found peculiar fragments; probably consist of elements wholly unspotted on Earth. Flexibility preserved in water, but hardened quickly after exposed to air. The joint research conducted by the Biology and Astronomy departments suggests that it is highly likely to be classified as unknown extraterrestrial material..."

"Awakened at A.F.3@1, awaken code-name Sanga.

The sculpting behaviour has been performed since awakening. The resulting art style, known for its bizarre surfaces and grotesque lines, is difficult to attribute to any specific genre. Though constantly unsettling its viewers, those works stay far from helping the dissolution research."

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
"At the day of @1 @1, the university cemetery was vandalized again. This marks the third grave-robbing incident this month.

After weeks of investigation, the Awakener Sanga has been preliminarily identified as the suspect by the association.

No doubt anyone visiting her workshop would be shocked by those various grotesque and blasphemous ocean-themed sculptures before questioning their material sources: the shell necklace Natasha wore for her burial; Aberdeen granite that shared similarities with tombstones. Unlike Pickman, who loves explaining his artistic concepts, Sanga is more elusive—our all queries resulting in nothing more than a smile.

Don't touch her chisel, and don't stay alone with her in her workshop—Professor Dexter warned us. However, radical measures are necessary to uncover the truth behind the grave robberies.

It's 00:45 on @1 @1. Member @2 of the Detective Enthusiast Association has sneaked into Sanga's workshop. Wish me good @3"

—Excerpt from "Detective Enthusiast Association, Investigation Record S-618"

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Cité Art Salon Exhibition, A.F.2@1.

"Let me take her home!" The assailant shouted while hammering at the sculptor August's final work, "The Nameless Ms. Coral," before hastily stopped by the congregation. However, this unstrung old man had surprisingly turned out to be none other than the long-reclusive August himself.

For a time, speculations and discussions about "The Nameless Ms. Coral" flooded in.

Some people said it was inspired by a female apprentice named Sanga, who was the actual owner of August's best works. August is merely a shameful plagiarist.

Some people said that Sanga came from an illustrious family—her father was a renowned writer, and her brother was a diplomat. In order to pursue the sculpture art, she disengaged with her family and set alone to Paris, living penuriously until her death.

Some people said Sanga suffered from a strange illness. Ominous black ooze streamed on her body, and her each carving transformed a part of her flesh into coral. "The Nameless Ms. Coral" was actually her coraled appearance, not a sculpture at all.

Other people said...

The apprentice, the devoted, the patient. Words pile upon Ms. Coral, sculpting her as the crowd dispersed from the exhibition hall. She blinks in the pouring moonlight. She's still waiting, and waiting—for her moment of returning home.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Watched by countless nights, the sculptor suffered from Dissolution slips beneath the murmuring waves, falling into writhing dreams:
As Lemuria's spirals inflamed by her kindreds, its majestic walls arise in her hands.

As the Father and His servants slumbering into epics, their statues find immortality under her carving.

Her senses dull. Her body stiffens. Her chisel nearly escapes.

Coral-like white mists have crept to her forearms. Hands tremble under her gaze. A smile flickers. Her life will fade like an extinguishing candle, while her body will step beyond eternal's door.

Her wish fullfilled as she sinking onto the seabed. Coral shattering to foam, black slime of Dissolution threads into the ocean—she finally embraces the City long-lost in currents, and mingles with its splendor—together, ever after.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Sanga, the sculptor from Cité, offers you her chisel. You may be flawed, but you are still worth carving.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: You chose the perfect carving knife for me.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Good taste.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Inspirations are endlessly flowing...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Absolutely amazing... Your offhand remark has resolved a creative problem that has been troubling me for months.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I am well acquainted with the pain of carving and the burning of transformation. Yet all of this fades when compared to eternal beauty.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: I need only a bit of stone, two chisels, and three sun-facing irises... and I can create anything for you.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: I shall convey these unspoken words to you through my work.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Thank you for preparing this studio for me. Everything here is bathed in sunlight; it seems that every piece of work, every carving knife, glows with a golden light. Oh, spring is golden.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: The sleeping sovereign murmurs in my ear, the ruins of the deep sea constantly reconstruct before my eyes... Have the countless dream scenes finally come true?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: A wonderful life lies in indulgence. Sometimes, you shouldn't be too hard on yourself.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Inspiration is like bubbles rising in the sea: a gentle touch, and they vanish. Are you the same?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: War, plunder, and fame are all human desires. The humble sculptor has no interest in what humans pursue; she only wishes to be a slave to beauty.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Smiles and etiquette serve as a layer of armor, helping me maintain distance from others and avoid tedious disturbances. As for my true self... I don't mind showing it to you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: My thoughts accumulate like white limestone and are washed into beautiful coral. They merge with me, pulsing with my heartbeat... Will you listen?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Ugh! Your temperature is a bit high for coral. But... it's warm and intense. I like it.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Past
voiceLines.content: I'm from Cité. There, everyone wants to be an actor; no one is content with just watching. In reality, we are merely the city's pitiful footnotes.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aurita
voiceLines.content: Pickman and I are working on some fascinating installation art, exploring the reconstruction of abstract representationism by deconstructing visual primitivism... Huh, why did Aurita faint?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Morning
voiceLines.content: The air on campus at 4 AM is refreshing. I'm glad you're willing to work out with me. I must say, sculpting is quite the workout.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: From Dissolution wounds flows not only black slime but also endless inspiration. Honestly, I wouldn't mind some more.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Did you know about the legend of that certain "Painter" here? From those expressionist graffiti, I sense a familiar touch...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I enjoy wandering aimlessly. Swamps, graveyards, infirmaries, abandoned castles... In these places, I always find unexpected delights.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Things I hate...? None. Would you hate a speck of dust or a leaf?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Explaining art is as ridiculous as explaining railroad stocks—please don't make life harder for us artists.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: I need to gather some carving materials, preferably fresh ones.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: What a glorious victory... I shall engrave this moment into eternity.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Sometimes, the beauty of art lies in its annihilation. But your failure... clearly doesn't fall into that category.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Stay focused.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Does it hurt?

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Come on.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Be careful.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Perfect!

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
A silver tongue is the nectar of a rosebud; lords and courtiers, the bees and butterflies that dance around its swaying bloom.

The thorns fed by desire have crept up on the rose window, coiling tightly around it.

People may gossip behind her back, and the crown may leave her hands torn and bleeding, but she will never relinquish the power she has drawn into her arms.

After all, this is the nourishment a rose truly needs to bloom.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
No one could point to the exact moment the "salon" wove itself into the upper crust of Londinium.

In this mysterious salon, one won the chance to have a master paint their portrait; another was granted a private supper with the Prime Minister; and yet another even received a promise from the Queen herself.

The host, the venue, the time—all remain a mystery. People only know that everyone can obtain what they desire most in the salon.

Yet none can say what it takes to please the hostess and earn an invitation.

Even Lord Dexter, famous for his social charm, was flatly turned away.

"Our apologies, sir. The hostess currently prefers the company of artists."

"The nobility? Please await a future invitation."

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
It began with nothing more than a glass of grape soda standing in for red wine.

In an unnoticed corner, Sorel adopted a delicate, pitiable expression, drinking with a mere two or three students.

Next came a modest afternoon tea.

In the student cafeteria, Sorel politely turned down the macarons offered by the students, her eyes lingering with a hint of genuine affection.

And finally, it culminated in a grand salon, and the full blossoming of a rose.

The lounge was lavished with flowers and jewels; the brilliant rose and young students toasted one another, thoroughly enjoying the elegant gathering.

The newly appointed Keeper witnessed it all, silently praying that her next move would not be "to become the principal of Mythag University."

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Sorel always knew she was beautiful, and in her heart, she regarded this beauty as a gift from heaven.

As long as she pleads with tearful eyes, people will melt with pity; a hint of vulnerability was all it took for her childhood playmates to take her side unconditionally.

However, beauty was worthless in the face of true power.

When her own parents sought to trade her to nobility for their own future, Sorel's tears tasted the bitterness of failure for the very first time.

Is there anyone who can help her? Could anyone rescue her from this ignorant and backward fate?

Is there anything, anywhere, that can transform her beauty into a real weapon?

As Sorel sobbed with her face buried in her hands, the messenger capable of stirring the currents of fate manifested before her.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Even now, as an Awakener, Sorel cannot forget those nobles who fawned over her, nor the endless parade of their sycophantic faces.

How utterly nauseating those smiling faces were: slick, mercenary, dripping with undisguised lust and calculation. Yet she had no choice but to weave a gentle web around such faces.

She would weave the most meticulous of webs, reaching into every dark corner, winning over every person, securing every ounce of leverage. She had to be like water slowly brought to a boil, letting those people grow comfortable in it, so that by the time they wished to remove their masks, they would find there was no escape.

But when she finally came to her senses, the one with no escape turned out to be herself.

No escape. No rest. No quitting.

Sorel had long since lost the right to turn back. Aside from standing above everyone, there was no other path for her to walk.

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content: Tawil does not exist in the current world. Their existence would draw the attention of the 'Supreme Will,' so They cannot and must not exist. Wisdom and silence are all The Gatekeeper can offer to these tireless seekers. In Their daily vigil, Tawil quietly bestows Their wisdom, courage, and silent blessings upon the fate of humanity.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
In a mysterious dream, I first saw Them.

In an endless and foggy space, They guarded a majestic and eternal Gate linking countless vast universes. Beyond the deep cracks of the Gate, strange illusions flickered like undeciphered signals. Upon catching a signal, I felt my body vanish, aimlessly floating among the stars, enshrouded by an incredible darkness. I was terrified; the dream violently shook, the heavy Gate irresistibly opening, with countless sphere-like objects shining like stars beyond it. The vast and unfathomable scene made me dizzy... and the Gate's guardian—Tawil—silently and eternally watched me.

—Ward Phillips, Silver Key Notes

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Tawil has manifested in Mythag only three times.

The first time, Tawil ignited the spark of "Wisdom." The Gatekeeper opened the passage to dream, imparting rare Knowledge to the ignorant founders of Mythag. They provided Mythag's original "think tank," along with clues and insights about Dissolution.

The second time, Tawil delivered the prophecy of "Change." The Black Pool churned, welcoming the Arrival of the one who would "Transform" the world.

The third time, They transmitted the signal of "Finale." Their cries and wails resonated across the earth, yet could not prevent the inevitable descent of Chaos and Destruction.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Kadath is not the only dream Tawil seeks to protect.

The Gatekeeper has witnessed the birth and destruction of countless planets and galaxies, with the histories of past and future sedimented into knowledge, absorbed into the Ultimate Gate behind Them. With a gaze full of compassion, Tawil looks down upon these scenes, which dissolve into fleeting glimpses in Their dreams, vanishing into the darkness of the boundless abyss.

Tawil once stepped onto a piece of land, but in the moment They glanced back, everything They cherished crumbled beneath the breath of the "Supreme Will."

After endless repetitions, They finally realized a harsh truth: Their very existence serves as the prelude to a nightmare; Their immense presence alone draws the gaze of the "Supreme Will." Their interference would only bring deeper misfortune to the world They hold dear.

Thus, Tawil retreated. Tawil fell silent.

Until They perceived a glimmer of change emanating from "It" within the drifting fragments of consciousness in the infinite expanse...

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content: As the Aeon of Sagacity's Proxy and Gatekeeper, Tawil has not lacked the desire to explore Their own essence. Tawil yearns to walk the earth like those The Gatekeeper watches over, witnessing the changes in civilization and the vicissitudes of history, gathering all They see into a treasury called 'Omniscience.' But Their existence does not allow Them to abandon Their post. Deep in Tawil's heart, perhaps what They envy most is the girl who carries a thread of Their will...

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Draped in shimmering jewels and trailing gossamer silk, she keeps her true self hidden beneath a facade of breathtaking splendor.

Thais may appear vain and frivolous—an impression held by many—but perhaps that is merely another mask she wears.

"My, what are you writing there? Here, let me help—

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
The flood that swept across the world washed away the treasures of civilization, but it also cleared the dust from history's pages.

When the waters finally receded, fragments of a forgotten past surfaced among the ruins of ancient Morsul.

The "Tree" stood at the Karage River's source, weeping crimson sap that flowed downstream to nurture civilizations.

The "Tree" was undying, ever-verdant through the ages.

Ultimately, modern historians concluded that the "Tree" had no physical form; rather, It was a metaphor for ancient civilization, a sacred, incorporeal symbol.

In every unseen corner of the world, its seeds have quietly taken root.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Mythag awakens and contains many Awakeners, but none are as unique as Thais.

She helps schoolgirls pick out makeup for dates; she helps the disheartened regain hope, and she helps investigators on the verge of mental collapse find their way back to the light.

She's like a lover, a sister, or above all, a mother. She has a gift for creating a quagmire called "love", quietly drawing people in and making them unconsciously willing to give everything for her—
Following the third intervention to prevent a student from drinking the mysterious liquid she provided, the Awakener Management Office issued a restriction order against her.

"Thais is strictly prohibited from approaching any student unless accompanied by the Keeper."

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
The name @2 appears time and again upon the pages of history.

Priestess. Mother. Queen. Sorceress. Too many titles have been attached to this name, leaving scholars unable to determine which one truly defines the Awakener we know today.

Thais herself does not hesitate to share her past with us—all of it is her, yet none of it is entirely her.

"It was she who was born of noble blood."

Thais was always the most radiant girl in the temple. As the child of the High Priest, she moved with a fluid grace and carried the gentle warmth of moonlight.

"It was she who knelt before the Tree."

Thais was the vibrant leaf on the "Tree"; her devotion had earned her the blessings of It.

"It was she who was bled dry."

When cataclysm struck and the pillars of civilization crumbled, the ancient, ignorant civilization chose her—their most exceptional daughter.

"It was she whose veins now pulse with crimson sap."

The "Tree" revered by all made its own choice. Its branches took root within her, granting her a near-eternal life.

"But it was not she who wished to destroy civilization."

The annihilation of the world was never what Thais desired.

"But Miss Thais, what do you truly desire?"

"My dear, didn't we agree? When our bond bears fruit, you will have your answer."

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
It truly exists.

It is the gaze cast by God, the branch God extends towards the universe.

It delights in the grandeur of history and hungers for the flourishing of civilization.

It seeks to transcend withering, to surpass death itself.

She longs for low, resonant chants, for dust and salt-laden winds, for silver leaves and the moonlight over Morsul.

Fiend, witch, sorceress... the judgments of mortals are mere trifles.

If even a single drop of blood escapes the black encroachment, They shall once more draw eternity into Their arms.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: My veins surge with the will to survive, screaming and driving me to spill my blood on every inch of this planet... Ah, I've rambled on for too long; do forgive me. I am Thais. Have you summoned me? Are you ready to merge with me?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Thank you for your efforts. Allow me to reward you in kind.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: My body is getting warmer.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Your generosity is greatly cherished...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Would you like to touch it? My heart beats because of your presence.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I'm so happy... You're so biased and favor me so much.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Others may get upset if they think you're showing favoritism.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Do you long for me as well?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Is this the manifestation of your desire, to deepen my affection?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: For all that you have given me, your love has already become one with mine...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Why not lose yourself in my love? Didn't you awaken me for the warmth of my embrace?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Why do you always avoid me? Are you shy? How cute, this reluctance to face your desires.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Hmm? You're wary of me, a woman of unknown origins? Very well... I was the deposed queen of Nineveh, the Shinarite who clawed at heaven's gate, and the girl who had her consciousness stolen beneath Euphrates' sacred bough... Where shall I begin, my wary one?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Since I am Awakened as your apostle, I seek nothing but your peace and joy, that is my wish... Ugh... Ahh... Yes, yes, I wish for survival, perseverance, reproduction, we must live on, LIVE ON...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I have always awaited the arrival of destruction, never considering "resistance"... Will you help my shallow soul cross the abyss? Even in a world where I narrowly survived, you still grant me salvation...

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
She is the singer among the stars, the shimmering stardust.

She is the bird trapped in a gilded cage, the discarded phonograph.

When her home planet collapse into the void, she is compelled to embrace the hope of life, becoming a wanderer in the unclaimed depths of space, an eternal seeker singing in search of home.

"Sister... Though I am the one who can walk freely among us, you have always been the one supporting me."

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
In the "P-063 Opera House @2 Event," a metal box was discovered in a corner of the burnt backstage, and the Silver inside was recovered.

The current instruments at Mythag University are unable to identify the material of the box. After consulting @2 documents and analyzing its decorative engravings, Professor Doll concluded that the box might originate from an extinct civilization that perished in an explosion centuries ago.

The Silver remains quiet and unremarkable while inside the box but emits a continuous humming sound when removed. Professor Doll suspects that the metal box functions as a signal blocker, preventing special frequency signals from resonating with the Silver.

The model of the resonating Silver has also been identified.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
After reuniting with Faint, Tinct settled down at Mythag University. After being injured again in the P-063 @ 2 Event, Tinct became even more fearful of strangers, leading her to become reclusive. Unlike her powerful and melodious singing voice, her everyday conversational tone is sweet and clear, but few have had the chance to hear it.

Some well-meaning individuals attempted to promote Tinct's performances on campus, even finding posters from her early opera house performances and plastering them around the campus.

Tinct is unwilling to cater to these wishes; such enthusiasm only stirs up memories of a past she wants to forget.

"End this absurd tragedy. As long as I'm by your side, I have no other desires. If possible, I wouldn't mind being forgotten by this world."

"Don't, Tinct. The days we will spend together are still long ahead. This is no longer our home planet, and I am no longer your burden. You should find the things you want to do and live for yourself."

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Unlike her obviously petite sister, Tinct's deformity manifests in other ways.

Whether it be mistletoe or hermit crabs, Tinct resembles a spirit body unable to survive without other individuals.

On the desolate planet, everything she did was to cure Faint's illness; she was willing to try any possible way to sustain her sister's life, even at the cost of enduring what ordinary people could not bear.

She paid no heed to the nobles' mockery and humiliation, always conducting unequal trades with them calmly and placidly, even pleading for their mercy—which granted her a seat to escape the desolate planet. The moment she secured it, she gave it to Faint without hesitation.

Yet, at the last moment, Faint pushed Tinct onto the star stream fleeing the desolate planet—hoping her sister could finally free herself and start anew on a new planet.

However, after the desolate planet's annihilation, Tinct embarked on a selfless drifting journey to find Faint, uncaring of being manipulated by others. Such Tinct was discovered by the @2 Church, and subsequently ended up in @3's hands.

Tinct never resisted. Rather, she hoped someone would tell her what was best to do—even if it were lies, deception, or an ephemeral illusion, it was better than standing paralyzed with no clue what to do.

At least, that suggested there was still hope for Faint's future.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
At this point, asking me about "a life of my own" may be asking too much.
I have grown used to dissolving beyond the sky, hiding away in the sea of stars.
It is not me the spectators watch. It is not me they toy with like a music box. It is not me drifting through that barren starlight. That is a tool that sells its voice to make a living, a corpse walking on in search of Faint. Only by believing that others are worth more than I am can I believe any of it was worth the cost.
So, at this point, please don't make me notice myself again.

"But little sister, stop drowning in a past that is already past.
Open your eyes and look. That voice of yours, the only one like it, is ringing all the way across the universe now."

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Thank you. You're too kind.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: I shall sing for you.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Yesterday, I dreamed of the day I started drifting through the stars again.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: The vast cosmos, the boundless deep space, and the seemingly endless journey... I felt so lost during that time.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: The spaceship was cramped and claustrophobic, like a metal coffin floating in space. I had been waiting for my Morning Star since forever, until you showed up for me.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Yes... I lost my voice back then. Your grace brought it back.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Will your side be the place where Faint and I finally find belonging?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: It has been a long time since I felt this way. I will take the stage in perfect form and deliver a song that embraces the whole cosmos just for you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Why am I always dressed in this gown? So I can sing for you at any time.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: What do I want to do for myself? Sorry, I don't understand what you mean. Actually, Faint has asked me this question many times, but all I want is for her to recover soon.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: During our time on that now desolate planet, the compassion of those influential figures provided my sister and me with the resources to survive. In the end, they also gave me the chance to escape the dying planet, though it was limited to one person. They are all my benefactors, just like you, Keeper, who gave me a place to stay.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Thank you for your guidance. I finally understand Faint's choice. I took everything for granted, not realizing the mental burden it placed on her. From now on, I'll try to live for myself.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Through the long, endless times, Faint and I only had each other. But now, I have a new significant person in my life. Keeper, please allow me to retract what I had said before. You are different. You see more than my songs and my appearance; you truly see me. This is why I will protect you, too. I will never turn my eyes away from you.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Singing
voiceLines.content: I don't deserve the title "Heavenly Voice." As long as you enjoy my singing, that's all that matters.

voiceLines.content: I never expected to see Faint again... I wonder how she has been doing since then. No matter how I ask, she only reassures me she's fine... Sigh. Ah, excuse me, I got carried away. I should thank you for reuniting us first.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Faros
voiceLines.content: That lady looks like a lighthouse... If I could have seen her dazzling light during the eternal night voyage, perhaps I wouldn't have become lost.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Ah, the calamity of destruction and misfortune... Why did it have to torment my sister and me?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Here are lush plants, tranquil air, and a remedy for my sister's illness. For the two of us, it is the most wonderful new home.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I love all lives. I love light. I want Faint to emerge from her secluded shell and experience the world with her own eyes and ears.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I fear loneliness, and the worry of being lost in endless darkness... So please, promise you will not leave my side.

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
The young King slumbers upon his throne. Upon waking, he issues his decrees, his authority reaching every corner of the world.

Yet before the sun has set, the King is already weary. He has grown tired of his own power and transcendent wisdom; tired of the fanatical worship of his followers, and of the long dreams that have stretched across aeons.

None know what he witnessed during his long sleep, but they should be grateful for the bliss of their own ignorance.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Until now, the oldest known human civilization was believed to have originated in Mesopotamia, a fact supported by a wealth of solid archaeological evidence.

However, humanity is never content with the known. When facing the vast, black seas of infinity, we do not hesitate to set sail into the unknown.

Perhaps this is not the first time we have been granted such warnings or hints. Theosophists once proposed a chilling hypothesis: that the cosmos is an awe-inspiring cycle, and our current world—and humanity itself—is but a transient link within it.

Far too many things have perished silently in these cycles, leaving not a shred of evidence behind. This is, in fact, a mercy; some forces are so ancient and extreme that even their lingering vestiges could exert an immeasurable and devastating influence on our era.

Take, for instance, the accidental discovery made by the crew of the Vigilant on the floor of the Southern Ocean. It has pushed our understanding of prehistoric civilization back by tens of thousands of years.

From this, we have learned of a civilization—complete with its own state, monarch, and peculiar faith—that was swallowed by a global deluge and has long lain dormant beneath the waves.

Were it not for the Mystia Treaty Committee's assistance in containment and censorship, human history might have been rewritten. But the world as it stands is not yet prepared for such a cataclysmic revelation.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Some Awakeners struggle to adapt to their new vessels and lives, while others embrace the change, pivoting eagerly into their second life.

Tulu belongs to neither category. Never has any Awakener displayed such blatant, naked indifference toward the modern world.

His aptitude is peerless; perhaps he has already peered through the veil of current crises and global shifts. Yet, he prefers to lose himself in the depths of sleep.

Despite having no desire for fame, he has become a figure of renown among both humans and Awakeners at the university. Researchers scrutinize his every move, churning out paper after paper on his behavior. The Departments of Archaeology and Astronomy frequently send invitations to academic symposia, almost always requesting him by name.

Tulu's influence among his fellow Awakeners is equally profound: Murphy grows sullen at the mere sight of him; Goliath seems perpetually locked in a silent, private rivalry with him; and Miriam treats his every word as divine law.

To all of this, he maintains a singular lack of affect—harboring no expectations, making no demands. He grants the occasional request only as the whim strikes him; otherwise, he remains unreachable.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
When he was chosen from among thousands of children and ascended the throne, Tulu was not even as tall as the blue stone throne.

Yet, no one dared to question his indifference or his perpetual slumber; all understood these to be the signs of a King listening to the divine.

The young King's decisions invariably solved every hardship, and his prophecies never failed to pass.

Tulu accepted this life: entering the dreams of a "God," meeting an existence beyond comprehension, ruling his nation through oracles, and sinking once more into sleep.

The gears of this civilization turned on the will of the divine. He was content to simply follow the current—to be nothing more than the sole "messenger" for a higher power.

However, Tulu held one prophecy back, the only one he never spoke: that the nation would be destroyed by a deluge, and their civilization would be entombed beneath the sea.

Because he knew all, he knew that their destruction was immutable. But he resolved that, in their final hours, they should not live in terror and despair.

This was his final decree—made not as an "Divine Envoy," but as a King.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
His transcendent wisdom exacts a heavy toll on his body; he must sleep for more than fifteen hours a day, and even in his waking hours, he is haunted by a persistent lethargy.

Within his dreams, he sometimes feels the fury of the gods; at other times, he glimpses the intersection of fractured timelines. Occasionally, he even wanders into the furthest depths, coming face-to-face with the Divine itself.

He has never sought their revelations or prophecies, yet no matter how he tries to evade them, the visions always come to pass.

He never asked for offerings. To be worshiped, to be feared—these were burdens thrust upon him by others, and they hold no interest for him.

To be reborn was nothing more than an unwelcome interruption of an eternal dream.

No need for invocation. No need for prayer.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Who dares disturb This One's slumber?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Fine. I shall consider it a subject's humble offering.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Do you seek This One's sigil branded upon your soul?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Do you covet my power so desperately?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Wait, without my permission...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Those who remain stubborn in their folly perform futile deeds.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Isn't it good to follow the will of heaven? Why resist the will of fate?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: To fulfill your wish, you are willing to sacrifice so much...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Very well. At this point, I can somewhat grasp your aim. Proceed.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I see your resolve. Before returning to the void, This One shall bear witness to mankind's heir defying fate. But now... rest is required.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: I see none of my vassals' traits in you... Perhaps that is for the best. Merely recalling that woman wearies me.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: I never demanded worship. Mortals' fervor only exhausts me further... Withdraw. I will sleep now.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: It has been a while since you awakened me. Have you no questions? Divine secrets? The absolute prophecy? Even the drowned continent's treasures... Nothing stirs your curiosity? Hmph... You are peculiar, indeed.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: To shoulder calamity's weight... it must be a heavy burden for your age. Tell me—had you known from the start that destiny is immutable... would you still have fought so fiercely? Keep your answer. Reflect as I rest. Your reply... interests me.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I am not omnipotent. Even I err. That woman's ruinous action was my miscalculation... Hence, I require your aid. That you may heed my summons, you may place a bed here, in my chamber.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Your insolence... This One shall interpret as a plea for eternal rest.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Slumber
voiceLines.content: My slumber spills dreams like poison. Approach not while I sleep—and wake me never without cause.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Divine Bloodline
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after acquiring either Awakener "Aigis" or "Murphy"
voiceLines.content: This girl... her veins undoubtedly carry my blood. No—I have not walked this earth long enough to sire progeny. And yet... her power mirrors my own.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Seafarers
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after acquiring any one of Awakeners "Miryam," "Goliath," "Caecus," "Sanga," or "Faros".
voiceLines.content: ...It matters not, so long as their zeal doesn't rouse me. Sharing quarters is tolerable.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution... Those vile black tides invade my dreams. Unbearable.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: No matter how many cushions you stack, a lapis lazuli throne can't compare to a feather bed. In this regard, there is something commendable about your place.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Preferences? A king should not indulge... yet if I could avoid tedious rites, a soft divan might suffice.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: They found my bones beneath waves and presume I enjoy water? Now they wish to build a pool outside my chambers? ...Ha. They may do as they will. As long as they cease troubling me with trifles.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: For a subject, you observe keenly. Before my next long sleep, I shall... grace this era with my presence.

voiceLines.content: Let's make it quick, Keeper.

voiceLines.content: Not worth mentioning.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
How could we ever forget the hero Uvhash? He was the finest of men. The warrior fell to his knees in the sunset-drenched sands, his body bathed in warm blood. Vultures circled above, singing his dirge:
<Italic:No tears shall honor you, no weeping shall lay you to rest,
For in life, your name had already conquered Rome.>

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Silver Core Number: B-005
Date of Excavation: @3, A.F.1@1
Excavation Site: Rural Flemish Lowlands—ruins of an unnamed ancient Roman mausoleum
Detailed Record: The core's original bearer, Ludwig Prynn, was sentenced to burn at the stake by the local Inquisition following a necromancy incident. Prynn claimed to have acquired this Silver Core on the battlefields of the Ninth Holy Crusade. He then traveled to the outskirts of Brabantum, where, alongside his "Servant from the Stars" and "Invisible Companion," he conducted blood rites to summon the "Great Unnamable."

Recorder: Ward Philips
—<Italic:Awakener Silver Core Acquisition Report: B-005>

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
"4:30 6-mile morning jog along the Aethis River. Argued with an elderly passerby and kicked a poodle into the air.

...

12:00 Lunch: Honey pancakes, olive appetizers, and... five servings of roast lamb? Unbelievable.

13:00 Headed to the Trout Fighting Club. Record: 10 wins, 0 losses. Fastest match: 3 seconds—the opponent forfeited out of sheer fear.

19:00 Watched <Italic:The Shepherd-King> at Corvint Theatre with the Keeper, got thrown out for shouting dangerous political opinions.

22:00 Found loitering near St. Marian Hospital. Highly probable motive: casing the facility for blood bags theft.

Observation ends; danger level: SSS."

—Excerpt from <Italic:Hannah's Awakener Observation Notes>

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
A "golem" forged by Caligura's court alchemist, Marcus Antys, at the cost of countless living souls.

Due to the imperfection of the alchemical ritual, he had to drink a large amount of blood daily. He killed Caligura's political enemies and helped him claim the throne of Rome.

The tyrant Caligura was murdered less than four years into his reign. The golem was also locked in the underground of the destroyed altar by enraged and fearful mobs, forced to endure hunger and thirst for nearly a thousand years.

Throughout the long centuries, he survived on the blood of rats. The thirst ingrained deep within his nature slowly drove him mad.

<Italic:Not enough, far from enough...>
During the @2 period, a Lavantian sorcerer found him, promising to free him on one condition: he must slaughter the Remouans on the battlefield.

<Italic:A deal like that? How could he refuse.>
He completed the task with ease, but there was a small complication: in his frenzy, he slaughtered every soul on the battlefield and drained them dry—including the sorcerer, and ultimately, himself.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Age@2, the ancient city of Akka.

A thousand years of thirst finally broke loose—kill, drink, kill, drink—until nothing remained before him but an endless desert and a vast litter of desiccated corpses, so dreadful a sight that even the vultures dared not draw near.

He knelt in the yellow sand and laughed, and laughed, and laughed.

Glorious! @1 glorious!

And now—he would crown this magnificent feast of slaughter with his own blood.

The warrior bit open his own wrist, drained himself dry, and collapsed at last into the vast crimson pool he had made.

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content: Wanda is clever, rich, and beautiful, and as she says herself, she lives to enjoy herself. She makes men her slaves, then sets her feet, cold as moonlight, on their backs. Venus in her laurel crown, she is evil and reverie made flesh, and in all this darkness she alone, tall and slender, shines.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Travel info: Curious History Exploration - Luxurious 7-Day Tour to Cambrian Castle
Date: A.F.3@2 June 18th-25th
Guide: Thomas @2@1
Brief itinerary:
Come on, uncover the mystery of the most infamous haunted castle from 300 years ago—Cambrian Castle!

We're tired of reading about the seductive lady and her twenty-five attendants in old books and silent films; it's all the same—so boring!

According to a Mythag expert who wishes to remain anonymous, there's been a new discovery in the area! @2@1 covered in thorns...

Call quickly @2@1@1. This trip will be unforgettable, chills guaranteed!

—Excerpt from "Worster Tour Group Disappearance CaseFile Summary: Evidence S-145"

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
On her very first day at Mythag, Wanda faced grave charges of "trampling others at will."
According to a student who wished to remain anonymous, he was simply passing the library when he happened to meet Wanda's eyes. He was then thrown to the ground, @2 and fitted with @3 (the student declined to give further details).
The whole ordeal lasted less than five minutes from start to finish. The conduct was vicious and appalling.
The Mythag Disciplinary Committee (hereafter the MDC) regards this matter with the utmost seriousness and extends its deepest sympathy. A special task force has now been formed, and Wanda will undergo continued and thorough correction of both attitude and behavior, so as to help her adjust to campus life as soon as possible.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
When that terrible plague came, Wanda had the castle gates welded shut with iron and settled into a life of pleasure, sealed off from the world entirely.
There were clowns to crack jokes and poets to improvise verse. There were musicians, there was fine food and wine.
Every joy and every safety lay inside the castle. Outside the castle lay a dark world that had been @2.
Just as the land beyond the walls became wholly dead, Wanda threw an extravagantly lavish masquerade for her several hundred followers.
It was three days and three nights of gorgeous, dissolute revelry. When midnight struck on the third day, some of the guests went utterly mad and others melted into puddles of black slime. Wanda's face cracked like porcelain, and black @2 ran out through the seams of her mask.
Her terrified followers huddled against her, shaking. She was perfectly calm.
One crack of her whip, and she ordered the ones who had gone completely mad to be @2, while the rest were to keep drinking and playing, without pause.
The lurid ball ended at dawn on the fourth day, the splendid hall awash with black @2 and red blood.
No one knows what happened in that place.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
"They who give themselves to fornication and lust shall suffer the punishment of eternal fire, as an example to all..."
For twenty-three days the monk stood outside her gate, reciting his dreary scripture.
Wanda had him bound and brought in.
The monk said, "Why be anxious over suffering? Where the spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom."
She stripped off his clothes.
The monk said, "Why be anxious over clothing? The lilies of the field neither spin nor bow their heads."
She cut off his limbs.
The monk said, "Why be anxious over blood? Of all that is flesh, nothing lives forever."
Wanda laughed. "I shall not merely make thee bleed. I shall make thee my slave, for life after life."
"Why?" The monk lifted his head. "Should you not have mercy on your fellow, as I have had mercy on you?"
Wanda studied him. His eyes were very blue, the blue of a clear sky.
She gouged them out.
The monk died in the end, unable to endure the torture. The local parish feared her money and her power, and not one soul dared accuse her.
Before he died the monk said, "@2 is near. You should—"
Years went by. Wanda had long forgotten the monk's face and his name; only his eyes stayed with her. On the night she was about to be devoured by @2, that unfinished sentence came back to her.
"@2 is near. You should—"
Her mind clouding over, she tried to guess how it ended, and found nothing.

Hmm... Although you're dull, you're not entirely unpleasant. Starting tomorrow, you shall serve me.
You don't want to...? Ha. This isn't a request; it is a command.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III

However... I request to retain the right to command you, merely for our mutual amusement. Come to my chambers tonight; I still have much to learn about human sensibilities...

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Winkle's office is known as the North Star of Mythag University. It remains perpetually illuminated, with every corner where a shadow might lurk driven away by an array of lights—from lanterns and kerosene lamps to tungsten bulbs and candles.

Her fear of darkness even causes her to avoid sleep. Thus, day and night, she can always be found huddled beneath the largest lamp, scrawling indecipherable symbols upon the draft papers scattered all over the floor.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Time: @1@2, A.F. 299
Location: Lab UG-C03, @2@1, @4, Londinium.

Participants: @1, @2, @4, @3
Test Subject: W
Subject Profile:
The subject's biological form is that of an adult human female, born on June 18, A.F. 280; origin unknown. While en route to her studies at @2 University, the original host succumbed to an illness and passed away. Subsequently, the extraterrestrial spiritual entity known as @1 occupied and reanimated the vessel, resuming the host's former life.

@1 possesses the abilities of spiritual migration and replacement and can visually perceive Dissolution. Although human bodies cannot perceive Dissolution, the inherent abilities of @1’s species allowed the subject to perceive its presence on a spiritual level. Therefore, when the subject first observed Dissolution 2 years and 8 months ago, she attempted spiritual migration to avoid further degradation.

While @1 retains the capacity to perceive Dissolution, the subject remains unable to sever its influence, and all attempts at spiritual migration have failed. After multiple futile attempts, the subject proactively contacted @3 University, requesting to be converted into an Awakener, which directly led to this experiment.

—Excerpt from <Italic:Experiment Record: The Feasibility of In-Vivo Silver Core Extraction>

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Hannah: How did you know that Mythag University could help you? You see, the general perception of us has always been "an obscure, unremarkable university." Was it Ramona who told you?

Winkle: Oh no, no, it wasn't. She did lead me in, but Ramona and I never really talk. My species, @1, has the ability of trans-spatial-temporal spiritual migration, so we know many things... Knowledge about Mythag is just one of them.

Hannah: So it was through that "knowledge" that you knew how to navigate the mist and find your way straight to the gate?

Winkle: I must admit, I didn't know about the mist. I just kept walking, and before I knew it, I was here. Speaking of the mist, do you know how terrifying that stretch of road by the entrance is? There are no streetlights, and when the mist rolls in, even the sunlight dims. And all those dark shadows...

Hannah: Is that why you avoid leaving your office? A fear of shadows?

Winkle: Shadows? No, no, you don't understand. It's not just the shadows, there's so much blackness, so many places where it could be hiding...

Hannah: It?

Winkle: Shh! Keep your voice down! You'll bring it here—no, it's not intelligent, but why, why is it that even after I reached here, @2@3@1
Hannah: Miss Winkle, are you okay?

Winkle: @2@3@1...

Hannah: Miss Winkle?

Winkle: Enough, get out! I'm done with this interview! Your shadow, your recorder, your notes—they're all black, black, black, black! Out, out, OUT!

Hannah: Miss Winkle—
—Transcribed from Hannah Peaslee's recording titled "<Italic:0810, Winkle Interview (Failed Attempt 1)>"

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Winkle once had a name of her own.

A name once steeped in her parents' tender love,
Once written over and over by friends, woven into memories,
And marked upon the calendar alongside her birthday.

Winkle once had a face of her own.

A face that once grew under her parents' watchful gaze,
That once beamed with joy and softened with sorrow in the company of friends,
And was captured in photographs alongside those memories.

Winkle once had a home of her own,
Vastly distant from Kadath, and bearing no resemblance to it.

In the end, it perished alongside her parents' very existence—
Swallowed by the blackness of @2, then utterly annihilated.

Winkle had a profound and heavy fear.

It is pitch-black, horrific, all-consuming, and utterly irrational.

It dissolves and erodes everything, wearing it down to nothing;
Once tainted, one's very existence turns to ash.

Winkle is left with only a name that once belonged to her.

A name the human tongue cannot utter, nor even mimic.

She can only close her eyes in moments of absolute exhaustion,
Praying for a dreamland where she might hear that familiar calling once more.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Survival is both an instinct and an unshakeable burden. In the face of a death that erases even memory, she alone is the proof that they ever existed—her parents, her friends, everything from her homeland.

So, she fled. She fled to an untainted world, to this ocean-covered planet, finding new life in the body of a deceased human girl.

But the black death has infinite patience.

Human eyes cannot see Dissolution, but she knew precisely what the chill at the edge of consciousness meant, what the darkness creeping through her mind signified—what humans call Dissolution has caught up, and without her knowing, had pinned her spirit and body together.

Again and again she tried to flee, and again and again she failed. Ultimately, utterly spent and with her mind pushed to its absolute limit, she could only drag her body toward the one place that might offer her salvation.

No matter the cost, she only wishes to live.

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Elegant, alluring—an Eastern "deity" of fatal charm.

Legend has it that when she lowers her fan, you will see the face of your most beloved reflected beneath.

Yet legends are merely legends. Pray that her gaze never falls upon you. Once she seeps into your memories like a pervasive night mist, nothing will remain of your mind but a delirious, hollow obsession.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
In A.F. @16@1, a cargo ship with no traceable voyage records or authorized paperwork silently docked at the Londinium Freight Harbor.

The vessel was later confirmed to have originated from a port in the ancient Panlong Empire of the Far East. On the night of its arrival, harbor workers and nearby residents reported a collective dream of an Eastern woman with raven hair, obsidian eyes, and skin like ivory.

Witnesses described her as both "fascinating" and "hauntingly familiar." Notably, several male witnesses exhibited catatonic symptoms while providing their accounts.

Mythag's Investigators searched the ship immediately. Strangely, despite pervasive sounds of giggling and high-level Gnostic Responses, no trace of a Silver Core was initially found.

The following day, Lord Dexter entered the hold. Inside a ceramic vase that had already been searched multiple times, he discovered a Silver Core enveloped in a thin, clinging mist. As of A.F. 314, this Silver Core was deemed "unawakenable" by all known methods.

It was not until the arrival of the current Keeper, @3, that the Silver Core awakened spontaneously. The resulting entity identifies herself as "Xu" and has requested a permanent link with @3.

—Excerpt from "Mythag University Silver Core Storage Records

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Xu appeared on campus just as naturally as she once drifted through palaces, royal tents, and various societies in the Far East. No one can say for certain when she first appeared.

To all who meet her, she feels instinctively familiar—a long-lost friend, or perhaps a cherished lover—even if they have never shared a single moment of their lives.

Only a rare few among the Awakeners maintain a preternatural wariness of her. Or, more accurately, only those of exceptional power can detect the anomaly: Xu, clinging and pervasive like a mist, seeping into their memories.

 The Mythag Administration once debated whether she required strict containment, even considering the development of specialized countermeasures. Yet, Xu dissolved these anxieties with a series of clandestine deals and a single promise:

"My intentions do not lie with these little ones."

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
...To offer sacrifice where none is due is named Profane Rites. It is a delusion that devours the wealth of the people, persisting despite every decree of prohibition.

The coastal folk are steeped in the habit of venerating false gods, driven by a passion for raising rustic shrines and unhallowed altars. Vast fortunes are squandered while fields and looms lie fallow, yet the hamlets remain blind to the rot within. Time and again, the magistrates raze these dens to the ground, only for them to sprout anew the moment the garrison withdraws.

Most grievous are the foreign vagabonds. Settling among our villages, they have taken their own sacred icons and turned them upside down, distorting them to resemble the sign for a "Well"—the character "井".

The deities enshrined therein—both the masters and their attendants—possess verifiable histories; they are largely women who met with violent or unjust ends. In the beginning, the flock consisted of mere peasant women, stage-players, and common streetwalkers.

But soon, wife brings husband, mother brings son, and the prostitute brings her patron. Having swollen in rank, they form shadow factions for private gain. It has become a dark wonder to see entire clusters of villages rally behind a single figure—some to infiltrate the halls of officialdom, others to raise private militias to wage war upon their neighbors.

@4@4@3@2
The following handwriting is illegible, except for several lines of very neat handwriting in @3. Translated by the Linguistics Department, the text reads:

<Italic:"Shameless old wretch. His views are so warped, his prose so utterly tedious. I was bored, so I raised a few crickets to watch them fight—and still, he must wag his tongue and prattle on about it..."

<Bold:"It's none of your damn business.">>

—Excerpt from a handwritten copy of <Italic:Wild Fox Study Gazetter>.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Have you ever felt the world grow so deathly quiet that you felt the urge to shatter something, just to hear the sound?

Lust is the silver vase she hurls; the prey startled by its chime... they will slaughter for love and be slaughtered by love, until their spirit is bled dry and only a hollow shell remains.

Then, those drained husks will offer her ever greater dominion, staining everything in sight with a bloody, delicious chaos.

A chaos that never ends.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: I am Xu, the Mistress of the Dreamless Land. If, in your heart, there is one you ache to see, yet cannot attain, I shall lower my fan and grant you a glimpse.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Do you anticipate a greater beauty from me, or a greater dread?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Such attentiveness makes me want to tease you all the more.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: These slight diversions are more to my liking than the offerings of my devotees.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: There was once a Princess born of Pleasure. Her robes were threaded with gold, her skin like ivory, the scent of agarwood drifted around her, and the mere sweep of her gaze could steal a soul.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I have almost forgotten her tale entirely, but it was one of Rapture, one of Cruelty, one that began with Abandonment and Retribution, and concluded with Sacrifice and Blind Obedience.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: She soon tired of the sport. Her devotees merely repeated the same theatre, consumed by the Love born of Lust, or the Lust born of Love. Their foolishness—their heartbreak over betrayal and loss—it bored her. Their tears, too, bored her.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: First Their bearing, then Their shape, until They also possessed a pair of... or rather, until all that remained memorable was a pair of beautiful, Soul-Capturing Eyes—eyes just like mine.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content:
Do you not love me? Then why cower when you are encompassed? Do you not loath me? Then why weep when there is no return?
Oh, now you fear my shadow? Has the fragrance of white magnolia become a cloying, inexplicable musk to you?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content:
Do not trouble yourself; you are not like those common multitude. 
Hush. Do not look behind me. Pay no mind to the unseen caress. Look into my eyes, and my eyes alone.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content:
Ah, you stare, enraptured by my fan again? Hehe. No matter whose face you desire, I shall let you have it. Come, draw closer—
Oh? You refuse? Such cold words, yet such an adorable expression...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content:
I am utterly bored this day. Is there no wish you require me to make manifest?

A pity you don't. So many are willing to wield the scythe and offer me sweetmeat for far more trifling ends.
But if it's you asking...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content:
Why does the Order of the Swelling Grace follow me, and what was its genesis? An amusing query. Have you, too, known the person unattainable, or the regret of failed struggle?
Hmm, it seems not. What a waste. That look of desperate struggle—it would be so very amusing to behold on your face.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content:
You are truly a marvel, so preoccupied with the trivialities of the corporeal, in a world already marked for ruin.

It compels me to take an interest myself.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
Beneath my fan, every soul sees the face of their most cherished. I lend this power to the weak, that they may wield it as a blade for my own amusement.

But perhaps—I only say, perhaps. If you were to be enthralled by it, I would know a true, unsullied Ecstasy.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: ...If you continue to trespass thus, the guise I adopt for you may not remain so agreeable.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis

All things end in the Void. Why not seek some further pleasure with me before then?

Rest assured, should the day come that you cannot resist the Dissolution further, I shall not allow It to claim you first.

I enjoy a spectacle, but decidedly not that sort. Pray, ensure they remain far, far away.

storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Language barriers? Not a problem—gestures work just fine. Uncontrollable power? At this school, that's par for the course. A few days in the lab usually resolve the issue.

With her beaming smile and a personality so blunt it borders on feral, Vortice quickly wins over the other Awakeners. Sure, she often wreaks havoc because she forgets what she's capable of (spare a thought for that fountain, rebuilt three times by now). But come on—she doesn't mean it!

...Probably.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
The North Atlantic whirlpool Moskstraumen was first observed in AF 1■■. Over the following centuries, it steadily grew in size. By AF 29■, Moskstraumen had evolved into a massive whirlpool roughly 260–300 feet (80–90 meters) in diameter, with currents stretching about 5 miles (8 kilometers) wide.

Beyond the powerful suction of the currents and devastating effects (claiming both marine life and fishing vessels in the vicinity), a greater threat lurked beneath Moskstraumen—a D-Rift. After prolonged observation and research conducted by Academy members, it was confirmed that the formation of Moskstraumen was directly linked to the D-Rift beneath it. In 1898, a formal operation was launched to purge it.

Within the D-Rift, the Academy recovered vast quantities of biological remains and shipwreck debris, along with a Silver Core later designated O-1841.

—Excerpt from <Italic:The Moskstraumen Incident Records>

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
The condition of Awakener Vortice is highly irregular. In an unrestrained state, her abilities do not activate at her own will. Irregular energy fields resembling the Moskstraumen vortex spontaneously form around her, pulverizing anything within range.

Physical contact with water-containing objects or people (including blood and other bodily fluids) accelerates field formation at the point of contact. Given both the involuntary trigger and the manic state she endured early in her Awakening, she was classified as "Extreme Danger."

To address this, the Awakener Department collaborated with the Physics and Chemistry Departments to develop "Vorticesteel"—a specialized synthetic alloy capable of withstanding her destructive power. This metal was fashioned into a muzzle and restraints for her to wear all the times.

Vortice's mental state began to stabilize after Researcher Caldwell's 11th "O-1841 Contact Experiment." During this trial, Vortice successfully internalized Moskstraumen's influence, significantly reducing the threat to her surroundings.

However, she cannot maintain this state without the "Vorticesteel" gear. Only when properly restrained can she stably contain Moskstraumen's effects within her core and channel its power for combat.

Upon regaining sanity, Vortice has revealed a cheerful disposition and an unexplained fondness for the Awakener Nautila. This likely stems from a shared experience tied to their spiritual origins.

—Excerpt from <Italic:Awakener Profile: Vortice>

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Even if she could speak in complete sentences, she couldn't tell you where she was born. In truth, regardless of which "home" you mean, all she can recall now is blinding white sand, dense jungle, and a boundless sea.

But if you ask her where home is, she will tell you in broken phrases and passionate gestures: Home is on the sea, drifting wherever the currents take it.

Long-time isolation kept her from understanding loneliness. Yet on that ship, she first knew the warmth of a family and the bond of friendship: She shared grilled fish and iridescent shells with her companion whose name was derived from Nautilus, sharing dreams of land, of voyage, of adventure. And in the end, they shared a death swallowed by black waves and the whirlpool.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Out on the boundless ocean, in the salty breeze, the ship gave her a family and friends beyond blood ties before the torrent swallowed everything. For the first time, she truly understood what loneliness was, and she never wanted to feel it again.

Yet for her best friend, her little family, she was willing to return to that pitch-black silence.

After the darkness covered everything, she was reborn in a new form. Sure, this new life comes with inconveniences—she keeps forgetting how destructive her power is—but the chance to make more friends still fills her with pure joy.

Of course, it would be even better if her best friend could remember the stories they once shared.

"Even better than better—super-duper better!"
